本周核心方向（ML × ferro / 凝聚态）

20 篇

新材料：机器学习势从近500种A₂O₃组成中筛至16个实验候选，确认3种新刚玉高熵氧化物，包括（Al、Cr、Fe、Rh、Sc）₂O₃及阳离子有序的（Al、Fe、Ga、Sc）₂O₃。稀土-过渡金属扩散生成与分层筛选处理约24万个结构，在DFT层面得到300余个低能磁性候选和5个热力学稳定相；AT₆X₄/AT₆X₅ Kagome家族则发现6种稳定且具稳健铁磁性的候选物。新方法：不可约笛卡尔自然张量网络建立了从偶极矩到弹性常数张量的等变原子学习框架，性能可与主流球谐模型相当。生成模型可解释性取得定量检验，O(3)等变注意力扩散模型从平衡快照恢复自旋玻璃微观相互作用，未见序列上的系数相关达0.993。面向铁电体，MD驱动PINN以GradNorm联合拟合离散极化和稳态相场残差，并经COMSOL验证参数识别与极化、应变、应力场重建。新现象：TDAP-eML显示光激发可重塑Si和FeSe中的晶格能量面与受力，大体系成本较TDDFT降低近3个数量级。二维交错磁体系提出双极化外尔半金属和量子晶体谷霍尔效应，Fe₂WTe₄、Fe₂MoS₄与Fe₂MoSe₄在含SOC时为具体候选；Nb₂SeTeO双层则可实现自旋陈数翻倍的II型量子自旋霍尔相。

  1. 01
    Autonomous Emergence of Hamiltonian in Deep Generative Models
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：arXiv:2604.20821v3 发布类型：替换 摘要：深度生成模型在复杂多体系统中的预测成功达到了前所未有的水平，例如 AlphaFold 3，这引出了一个认识论问题：这些网络是否只是通过高维插值记忆数据分布，还是能够自主推导出其潜在的物理定律？为回答这一问题，我们提出了一个用于提取生成模型所学习的隐式物理相互作用的框架。利用扩散模型得分场的零噪声极限与热力学回复力之间的严格等价关系，我们直接将训练后神经网络的内部相互作用结构与物理哈密顿量进行比较。我们将该框架应用于一种依赖序列且具有受挫效应的一维 O(3) 自旋玻璃，探究了仅在热平衡快照上训练的 O(3) 等变注意力架构的潜在表示。在不施加局域性截断或构型无关性约束的情况下，该架构中的稠密标量矩阵呈现出局域性，并形成几乎与构型无关的系数；这些系数在 2,000 条未见序列上的皮尔逊相关系数达到 0.993，恢复了自旋玻璃的微观相互作用。这为深度生成模型中哈密顿量的涌现提供了定量且可证伪的证据。 类似地，在显式水苯酚实验中，网络仅使用坐标数据进行训练。在具备足够表达能力的情况下，由分子图引导的 Pairformer 恢复了主要的键、键角和适当扭转势平均力势（PMF）扇区。将构型依赖系数进行保持扇区结构的投影并映射为常数后，在未见过的分子动力学（MD）数据上得到 (Rcₒₙₛₜ²⁼⁰.9669)，为哈密顿量部分涌现提供了分子尺度的证据。

    📐 方法要点：利用扩散模型得分场零噪声极限与热力学回复力的严格等价关系，解析O(3)等变注意力网络的内部标量矩阵；训练数据为一维受挫、序列依赖O(3)自旋玻璃的平衡快照。

    🔗 相关工作关联：区别于只以生成质量评估扩散模型的路线，该工作直接将网络隐变量对应到哈密顿量耦合。其不预设局域截断或构型无关性，却恢复出近局域、近构型无关的相互作用。

    💡 对你方向的启示：可将已训练的等变扩散模型用作反演自旋模型的工具，并以未见构型上的耦合相关、力场误差和局域性作为验证指标。文中2000条未见序列相关系数0.993可作为可解释恢复的高标准。

    阅读原文 ↗
  2. 02
    快速且可解释的UF机器学习势的基准测试
    Benchmarking of Fast and Interpretable UF Machine Learning Potentials
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）已成为分子动力学模拟中替代密度泛函理论（DFT）的有力方法，能够以小得多的计算成本提供接近DFT的精度。然而，许多最先进的MLIP仍然计算开销较大，并且像黑箱一样运行，限制了物理可解释性。在本工作中，我们评估了超快速力场（UF³）势，该势采用带三次B样条基的线性回归来表示有效的二体和三体相互作用。我们表明，UF³表现出可与GAP、MTP、NNP（Behler-Parrinello）和qSNAP等既有模型相当的精度。我们进一步通过计算六种元素体系的熔点来研究UF³的可迁移性；这些势在拟合时未使用任何固-液界面构型，也未显式使用关于熔化的热力学信息。该模型对简单金属（Ni、Cu、Li）可在约6%以内复现实验熔点，但对Mo和Si的熔点显著低估，并且未能为Ge给出稳定的势，这反映出对于具有强角向键合或共价键合的体系，固定展开并截断到三体项的模型存在局限。我们还说明，UF³基于样条的形式允许直接可视化学习到的相互作用，从而能够识别黑箱方法常常掩盖的非物理行为。

    📐 方法要点：UF³以三次B样条基和线性回归表示有效二体、三体相互作用，针对多类材料基准比较能量、力及简单金属熔点预测表现，并直接可视化学习到的势函数。

    🔗 相关工作关联：其精度可与GAP、MTP、Behler-Parrinello神经网络势和qSNAP竞争，但模型表达形式比深度势更透明。对Mo、Si、Ge等强角向或共价体系的失效揭示了低阶体项的限制。

    💡 对你方向的启示：可先以UF³进行大规模预筛和势函数体检，再将高误差的角向成键区域交给更高表达力模型。对磁性合金或氧化物，应单独检验缺陷、相变和多配位环境，避免只凭常规能量误差部署。

    阅读原文 ↗
  3. 03
    利用不可约笛卡尔自然张量的原子级机器学习
    Atomistic machine learning with irreducible Cartesian natural tensors
    🎯 核心📖 Nature Communications

    📄 摘要：笛卡尔张量理论催生了 CarNet，这是一种统一的机器学习框架，能够以领先的精度预测分子和材料的性质，预测对象从原子间势能一直延伸到复杂的高阶弹性张量。

    📐 方法要点：构建笛卡尔自然张量网络，并给出不可约张量的构造、乘积、分解和重构规则；据此训练保持旋转对称性的等变原子间势，同时预测偶极矩、弹性常数等张量性质。

    🔗 相关工作关联：该路线以不可约笛卡尔张量实现通常由球谐函数承载的对称性处理，避免球坐标基的部分实现复杂度。模型在材料和分子势能面上可与领先球面等变模型相当。

    💡 对你方向的启示：铁电、压电和磁弹性任务可共享同一张量主干，同时输出极化、应力和高阶响应。建模时应按张量不可约分量定义损失，而非逐笛卡尔分量独立回归，以保持旋转协变性。

    阅读原文 ↗
  4. 04
    利用机器学习力场研究高压自由基聚合过程中聚乙烯的第一性原理原子结构与动力学
    First-Principles Atomistic Structure and Dynamics of Polyethylene During High-Pressure Radical Polymerization via Machine Learning Force Fields
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：聚乙烯（PE）是最常用的合成聚合物之一。尽管 PE 的合成和加工工艺已经十分成熟，但在原子尺度上精确确定其微观结构，即每个原子的位置，仍主要局限于高度晶化体系。人们通常通过使用经验原子间势的计算机模拟来弥补这一缺口；经验势以近似但高效的方式描述原子间相互作用，从而达到描述大分子所需的长度和时间尺度。这些经验势通常能够较好地描述体相性质和/或集体性质，但在复杂体系中会面临化学真实性方面的挑战，例如反应过程中的体系。在本工作中，我们将深度势（DP）机器学习力场的计算效率，与由 SeA 高通量框架实现的、经第一性原理范德华修正的杂化密度泛函理论（DFT）的化学真实性相结合，以应对这一挑战。利用该方法，我们研究了常见高压，即超临界，自由基聚合条件下乙烯溶剂中的 PE 低聚物和聚合物的结构与动力学。我们发现，当链长大于约 n ≃ 6 时，含自由基 PE 低聚物的局部溶剂化环境趋于收敛，这表明在低聚物上训练的机器学习力场可以扩展到明显更长的聚合物。随后，我们通过表征单链结构与动力学的分子量标度关系，进一步确认这些模型能够扩展到长 PE 链，并发现其表现出经典的良溶剂行为。我们的 PE 机器学习力场在广泛的热力学状态点和链长范围内、以完整原子分辨率保持了稳定且一致的精度，从而为基于第一性原理的聚合物结构与性质预测铺平了道路。

    📐 方法要点：以深度势机器学习力场结合含范德华修正的杂化DFT，模拟超临界自由基聚合条件下乙烯溶剂中的聚乙烯低聚物和聚合物，考察链长依赖的局域溶剂化与动力学。

    🔗 相关工作关联：相较经验聚合物力场，该方案保留反应自由基及复杂局域化学环境的第一性原理标定。结果与聚合物良溶剂中的经典链构象规律一致，但面向高压自由基条件。

    💡 对你方向的启示：处理反应性聚合体系时，可先验证约6个重复单元后的局域环境收敛，再扩展到长链采样。训练集应覆盖自由基端基、链增长构型和高压溶剂化结构，而非只使用中性短链。

    阅读原文 ↗
  5. 05
    面向WS₂氧等离子体相互作用的通用机器学习原子间势微调
    Fine-Tuning a Universal Machine-Learned Interatomic Potential for Oxygen Plasma Interactions with WS₂
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：等离子体—表面相互作用的分子动力学模拟要求原子间势同时具备准确性、计算效率，并能够描述反应性体系中的多种元素和成键类型。从原理上说，机器学习原子间势的基础模型可以满足这些要求。我们探讨了Meta FAIR开发的通用原子模型（Universal Models for Atoms，UMA）在氧等离子体物种与多层WS₂这一有前景二维材料相互作用中的应用。我们以针对Open Catalyst 2020（OC20）任务预训练的uma-s-1p1模型为起点，实施了迭代式微调循环。即使在没有微调的情况下，预训练模型也能再现所关注的生产尺度观测量，即在15 eV的O⁺和O₂⁺轰击下化学吸附的S和O覆盖率。这些结果是在未采用自旋极化和Hubbard U修正的情况下获得的。然而，采用包含自旋极化和Hubbard U修正的微调后，能量和力的平均绝对误差（MAE）分别降低至4.5×10⁻³ eV/atom和0.076 eV/Å。

    📐 方法要点：从预训练通用原子模型uma-s-1p1出发，围绕氧等离子体物种与多层WS₂的碰撞、吸附和反应构型进行迭代微调；训练标注纳入自旋极化与Hubbard U修正。

    🔗 相关工作关联：这属于通用MLIP向特定等离子体-表面化学迁移的案例，而非从零训练势函数。未经微调已能给出实用尺度的化学吸附硫、氧覆盖率，微调后能量和力MAE分别为4.5×10⁻³ eV/atom和0.076 eV/Å。

    💡 对你方向的启示：对过渡金属硫族化物缺陷工程，可将预训练势作为起点，并在自旋、强关联及高能入射构型上补标注。验证不应止于能量力误差，还应比较覆盖率、溅射产额和缺陷类型分布。

    阅读原文 ↗
  6. 06
    通过机器学习分子动力学确定气态巨行星内部的氢氦不混溶边界
    Hydrogen-helium immiscibility boundary in gas-giant planetary interiors from machine-learning molecular dynamics
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：氢氦（H/He）不混溶边界的位置决定了氦雨是否会在巨行星中发生以及发生在何处，但由于高压实验具有挑战性，同时第一性原理模拟受到体系规模和模拟时间的限制，该边界的位置仍不确定。我们利用由分别基于PBE、vdW-DF和混合HSE三种密度泛函近似训练的机器学习势驱动的大规模分子动力学，通过计算成分依赖的化学势来绘制这一边界。在100–1000 GPa的压力范围内，析温通常比以往使用小体系的第一性原理模拟低约2000 K；这一差异大于对所选密度泛函、机器学习势、忽略核量子效应以及统计不确定性的误差估计。将H/He混合自由能拟合为Redlich–Kister正规溶液模型，可以解释相分离的热力学驱动力，并为该边界提供预测性表示。与当前行星内部剖面的比较表明，土星中发生氦雨是合理的，而木星较热的内部则不太可能发生氦雨。我们的结果缩小了H/He不混溶边界的不确定性，并为建立能够耦合巨行星中相分离、热输运和成分梯度的行星模型提供了输入。

    📐 方法要点：分别基于三种密度泛函近似训练机器学习势，开展大规模氢氦分子动力学；由成分依赖化学势计算100-1000 GPa范围内的氢氦不混溶边界。

    🔗 相关工作关联：相较小尺度第一性原理分子动力学，该工作利用ML势扩大体系和时间尺度，并显式比较泛函依赖性。得到的析出温度通常比既有小体系结果低约2000 K。

    💡 对你方向的启示：高压相分离问题应将化学势和自由能作为主要可验证量，而不能只比较结构函数。可采用多泛函训练的势集合估计电子结构近似带来的边界不确定性，并与行星内部温压剖面直接交叉。

    阅读原文 ↗
  7. 07
    机器学习引导的刚玉型高熵氧化物发现
    Machine Learning Guided Discovery of Corundum High Entropy Oxides
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📄 摘要：高熵氧化物（HEO）领域早期的观点强调了其可能具有丰富的种类，组合学论证也暗示了大量新材料的存在。然而，实验现实更加复杂：仅依据离子半径、晶格几何结构和电荷平衡考虑，无法直接预测高熵氧化物的稳定性。在本研究中，我们采用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）预测由一组选定三价阳离子构成的A₂O₃型高熵氧化物的可合成性。在近500种可能的组成中，我们筛选出16种有希望的候选物进行固相合成和燃烧合成实验验证。我们发现了3种刚玉结构的新型高熵氧化物，其中包括（Al、Cr、Fe、Rh、Sc）₂O₃，以及一种新颖的阳离子有序相（Al、Fe、Ga、Sc）₂O₃。到目前为止，最常见的合成结果是竞争相的混合物，其中有时还伴随氧化还原反应。我们的结果还揭示，最终产物高度依赖合成方法；在测试的16种组成中，仅有3种在两种合成方法下表现出定性等价的结果。我们据此得出结论：高熵氧化物的实际出现率远低于最初的预期，而机器学习方法能够有效地帮助我们在“海量候选中寻找少数目标”。

    📐 方法要点：使用机器学习原子间势评估近500种由三价阳离子组成的A₂O₃高熵氧化物可合成性，筛出16种实验候选并完成合成验证，同时分析多相竞争和合成路径效应。

    🔗 相关工作关联：工作将高熵氧化物筛选从混合熵或单一结构稳定性判断，推进到ML势辅助的竞争相评估和实验闭环。发现实际可形成的单相材料远少于早期宽松预测。

    💡 对你方向的启示：高熵铁电或磁性氧化物筛选应将目标相与所有可及竞争相一并纳入，而非只比较理想随机固溶体。候选清单需按合成路线分别排序，并优先实验验证相稳定窗口较宽的组成。

    阅读原文 ↗
  8. 08
    利用机器学习哈密顿量实现可扩展的光激发诱导分子动力学
    Scalable photoexcitation-induced molecular dynamics with machine-learned Hamiltonians
    🎯 核心📖 arXiv

    📐 方法要点：在含双极磁性半导体的一维约瑟夫森结中计算平衡超电流，利用自旋分辨能带的内禀交换分裂，通过栅压改变化学势；进一步纳入Rashba自旋轨道耦合。

    💡 对你方向的启示：器件设计可优先测试栅压扫描下的0-π转变与异常相位偏移，并避免将有限Rashba耦合直接等同于二极管整流。后续计算需纳入界面透明度、无序和多通道输运以评估可观测窗口。

    📄 摘要：在铁电体多尺度建模中，将原子尺度模拟与连续尺度相场模型（PFM）结合仍是一项基础性挑战。一个关键困难在于，如何在连续建模框架中忠实捕捉离散的原子尺度信息，同时准确表征介观尺度的材料行为。本文使用由分子动力学（MD）数据驱动的物理信息神经网络（PINN）。该网络的损失函数由两部分构成：一部分是监督项，用于拟合由含畴壁体系的 MD 模拟得到的离散空间极化分布；另一部分是基于物理的项，其中纳入稳态 PFM 偏微分方程（PDE）的残差。为确保不同损失分量之间稳定且平衡的训练，我们采用自适应梯度归一化方法（GradNorm）动态调整任务权重。通过最小化总损失，该模型不仅能够重建连续尺度下的极化场及其相关应变、应力和能量图景，还能够识别相场模型的关键物理参数，包括特征能量密度、特征长度因子、梯度能各向异性因子以及朗道多项式系数。通过在 COMSOL Multiphysics 中使用 PINN 预测的物理参数，并在有限元框架内求解相应 PDE，我们证明这些参数能够准确再现铁电畴结构及相关材料响应，包括应力/应变分布和能量图景。该框架为建立原子尺度与连续尺度描述之间的多尺度联系提供了一种有效方法，并有望针对广泛材料体系直接从极化分布中推断潜在物理性质。

    📐 方法要点：以含畴壁的分子动力学离散极化数据训练物理信息神经网络，同时最小化数据拟合项和稳态相场方程残差；采用GradNorm自适应平衡损失，并以COMSOL有限元验证。

    🔗 相关工作关联：不同于直接由DFT拟合Landau系数或纯数据驱动超分辨，该方法把原子尺度MD与连续相场方程联合约束。输出不仅是极化场，还包括应变、应力、能量场及相场参数。

    💡 对你方向的启示：可用于从原子模拟反演铁电相场的梯度能、弹电耦合和Landau参数。训练集应覆盖多取向畴壁、不同边界条件和温度；参数识别后须用独立有限元畴演化或尺寸效应验证。

    📐 方法要点：构造包含交错磁性和自旋群对称性的四带晶格模型，分类I、II、III型双极化外尔半金属；再用第一性原理筛选二维材料，并在SOC下分析晶体谷霍尔响应。

    💡 对你方向的启示：可针对候选交错磁体计算自旋群对称性、节点极化和边界谱，再评估SOC开隙后的谷霍尔量子化。实验上应结合应变、栅压或层数调节费米能级至拓扑能隙附近。

    📐 方法要点：对AT₆X₄和AT₆X₅层状Kagome家族各78种替代组成进行高通量DFT，评估热力学稳定性、共线磁基态和电子结构，并以交换相互作用解析磁序来源。

    💡 对你方向的启示：Kagome磁体搜索应在初筛阶段就计算层间交换和不同层间堆垛，而非只比较面内FM/AFM。对入选铁磁体可继续检验K点附近色散带、SOC诱导能隙和异常霍尔响应。

    📐 方法要点：将连续时间流模型或扩散模型学习到的输运改写为波函数流下的幺正演化，使末态玻恩分布逼近目标分布；以张量网络压缩表示时变势和量子态，并测试稀有事件采样。

    🔗 相关工作关联：该工作把生成模型推断连接到量子模拟和张量网络，区别于在高维网格上直接积分连续流。空间维度8时，存储相较稠密网格降低约7个数量级，演化时间较基线外推值至少降低3个数量级。

    💡 对你方向的启示：可探索将高维凝聚态构型分布映射为低纠缠波函数流，以压缩生成采样。实际应用需监控张量网络键维增长、幺正近似误差及稀有事件尾部统计，并与传统重要性采样基准比较。

01

本周总览#

先把握一周的主线，再进入交叉重点与专题全文速览。

整体概览

本周文献显示，铁电与磁性研究集中于交错磁性、铁子动力学、拓扑输运和低维畴结构调控。CrSb中g波交错磁序的三维体敏感成像、NbOX2中相干铁子振荡的非易失电场控制，以及晶胞尺度偶极玻璃的低温储能，是实验突破最集中的方向。AI/ML工作则从机器学习势、神经算子和物理信息神经网络，延伸至闭环材料发现、DFT加速和等离子体实时控制。总体趋势是将对称性、守恒律、量子几何和实验反馈直接嵌入模型，而不是仅依赖黑箱拟合。

趋势观察

交错磁性研究从能带自旋劈裂的理论分类转向序参量的实验成像，CrSb的g波对称性、MnF2和CoF2中的交换及压磁机制构成代表案例。铁电领域出现从静态极化表征转向相干铁子、极化波、畴壁重构和晶胞尺度极性无序的趋势，NbOX2、BiFeO3纳米针和偶极玻璃分别覆盖超快动力学、纳米畴稳定和低温储能。磁振子、声子、激子与拓扑输运的耦合继续增强，涉及NiPS3、CrSBr、KTaO3、Co3Sn2S2及多种范德瓦耳斯异质结构。AI/ML方法由性质预测扩展到机器学习哈密顿量、电子-磁振子耦合、神经算子和量子多体波函数。闭环材料发现、无机合成规划和托卡马克控制表明，模型评价标准正从离线误差转向预算约束、物理一致性、实验可验证性和长期稳定性。

后续展望

后续实验应优先检验交错磁序的动量空间节点结构、铁子相干辐射的电场保持机制，以及极性偶极玻璃在4 K以下的疲劳、击穿和频率响应。AI/ML方面，机器学习势、神经算子和大语言模型需要结合不确定性校准、分布外测试、守恒律约束与真实实验闭环，避免以较低残差或较高静态准确率替代材料可合成性和长期动力学验证。

交叉研究#

01

二维Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型中的耦合各向异性弱拓扑态与Floquet混合宇称交替磁性#

Coupled anisotropic weak topological states and Floquet mixed-parity altermagnetism in two-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger models

中文摘要

Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）拓扑系统和交替磁性（AM）态是凝聚态物理中的两个重要研究方向。在单一体系中实现SSH晶格与AM相之间的耦合态仍然具有挑战性。然而，Floquet工程改变了这一点。我们的工作构建了五种二维（2D）SSH模型，并通过紧束缚（TB）方法描述SSH弱拓扑态与AM有序的耦合相。我们系统研究了圆偏振光（CPL）和相对原子位移（RAD）作用下，二维SSH晶格中能带结构、自旋劈裂和拓扑相变的演化。结果表明，跃迁参数（t1和t2）的不等性是SSH拓扑态和AM有序的根本来源。对于二维非磁态，可以通过晶胞选择实现由Zak相支配边缘态的各向异性弱拓扑态，类似于传统的一维SSH模型。共线反铁磁态保持自旋简并能带结构和内禀弱拓扑性质。此外，Floquet工程引入奇宇称p波AM相，而RAD引入偶宇称d波AM相。通过结合这两种效应，可以实现混合宇称（非奇/非偶宇称）AM相，从而实现用光场同时控制自旋劈裂和拓扑边缘态。Floquet工程和RAD在二维矩形SSH晶格中的物理机制同样来自t1和t2的不等性，这不仅可以通过TB方法得到充分理解，而且与二维碳基材料的第一性原理计算结果高度一致。本工作为在二维体系中耦合各向异性SSH弱拓扑态与多宇称AM有序建立了一个有效的理论平台。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.27329v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) topological systems and altermagnetic (AM) states are two important research areas in condensed matter physics. Realizing the coupled states between the SSH lattices and AM phanse in a single syetem remains challenging. However, the Floquet engineering change it. Our work constructs five two-dimensional-(2D-) SSH models to describe the coupled phases of SSH weak topological state and AM order by tight-binding (TB) method. The evolution of band structures, spin-splitting, and topological phase transitions under the circularly polarized light (CPL) and relative atomic displacement (RAD) in 2D SSH lattices were systematically investigated. The results reveal that the inequality of hopping parameters (t1 and t2) serves as the fundamental origin of SSH topological states and AM order. For the 2D nonmagnetic state, anisotropic weak topological states with Zak phase governed edge states are realized by unit cell selection, similar to the conventional 1D SSH model. The collinear antiferromagnetic state preserves the spin-degenerate band structure and intrinsic weak topological properties. Furthermore, the Floquet engineering introduces the AM phase of odd-parity p-wave while the RAD introduces the AM phase of even-parity d-wave. By combining the two effects, the mixed-parity (non-odd/non-even parity) AM phase could be realized, achieving the simultaneous control of the light field of spin-splitting and topological edge states. The physical mechanisms of Floquet engineering and RAD for the 2D rectangular SSH lattice are also from the inequality of t1 and t2, which can be not only fully understand by the TB methods, but also in good agreement with the first-principle calculations of 2D carbon-based materials. This work establishes an effective theoretical platform for coupling anisotropic SSH weak topological states and AM orders with multi-parities in 2D systems.

中文摘要

我们提出了一种加速材料发现框架，该框架将基于扩散的晶体结构生成与分层筛选相结合，以识别同时实现高磁化强度和热力学稳定性的新型稀土-过渡金属磁体。利用这一工作流程，我们系统探索了 3000 多种二元 (R-T) 和三元 (R-T-T') 组成，其中 R 属于 Y、Sm，T 属于 Fe、Co、Ni，T' 属于 Ti、V、Cr、Mn、Cu、Zn，并通过机器学习原子间势预筛选和自旋极化密度泛函理论验证，对约 240000 个生成的晶体结构进行了过滤。我们在 DFT 水平识别出 300 多个处于凸包上方 0.1 eV/atom 以内的低能磁性候选物，其中包括 5 个热力学稳定相。最高饱和磁化强度在富 Fe 二元和三元相中达到约 1.8 T，包括 SmFe₁₂、YFe₁₂、YFe₁₈Ti 和 Sm₂Fe₁₆Mn。对称性分析表明，大多数三元候选物是已知二元原型通过 Wyckoff 位点分裂以容纳 T' 取代而形成的子群衍生结构。位点分辨磁矩分析进一步显示，Mn 与 Fe 子晶格铁磁排列且磁化损失很小，而 Cr 则发生反铁磁耦合，从而为掺杂元素选择提供系统性指导。这些发现展示了一种可推广的靶向磁性材料发现策略，并表明将生成式搜索扩展到更大晶胞（>20 个原子）和更高 Fe 含量，是通向饱和磁化强度超过 1.8 T 的稳定相的一条有前景路径。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.25270v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an accelerated materials discovery framework that combines diffusion-based crystal structure generation with hierarchical screening to identify new rare-earth--transition-metal magnets simultaneously achieving high magnetization and thermodynamic stability. Using this workflow, we systematically explored over 3000 binary (R-T) and ternary (R-T-T') compositions spanning R~in Y, Sm, T~in Fe, Co, Ni, and T' in Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Cu, Zn, and filtered approximately 240,000 generated crystal structures through machine-learning interatomic potential prescreening and spin-polarized density functional theory validation. We identify 300+ low-energy magnetic candidates within 0.1~eV/atom above the convex hull at the DFT level, including 5 thermodynamically stable phases. The highest saturation magnetization reaches sim1.8~T in Fe-rich binary and ternary phases (SmFe₁₂, YFe₁₂, YFe₁₈Ti and Sm₂Fe₁₆Mn). Symmetry analysis reveals that the majority of ternary candidates are subgroup derivatives of known binary prototypes through Wyckoff site splitting that accommodates T' substitution. Site-resolved magnetic moment analysis further shows that Mn aligns ferromagnetically with the Fe sublattice with minimal magnetization loss, whereas Cr couples antiferromagnetically, providing systematic guidance for dopant selection. These findings demonstrate a generalizable strategy for targeted magnetic materials discovery and suggest that extending generative searches to larger unit cells (>20 atoms) with higher Fe fractions is a promising route toward stable phases with saturation magnetization exceeding 1.8~T.

页内定位所在专题
中文摘要

反常霍尔效应（AHE）和反常能斯特效应（ANE）分别描述磁性材料中的横向电响应和热电响应，在自旋电子学和能量收集应用中具有前景。本文采用高通量第一性原理计算研究了 2251 种化学取代的四方 L1₀ 合金。在铁磁体中，增强的响应更倾向于出现在来源于小交换劈裂母体化合物的合金中：没有一种来源于典型 L1₀ 铁磁体 FePt 的合金达到高响应区域，而来源于 NiPt 和 CoIr 的合金大量占据该区域。小交换劈裂使多数自旋和少数自旋能带保持在费米能级附近，从而使化学取代有更多机会改变近费米能级的能带交叉并放大 Berry 曲率。我们预测 (Co₀.₈Fe₀.₂)(Ir₀.₇Pt₀.₃) 中存在 2809 S cm⁻¹ 的巨反常霍尔电导率，并预测 (Ni₀.₈Co₀.₂)(Pt₀.₇Ir₀.₃) 中存在 7.72 A m⁻¹ K⁻¹ 的巨反常能斯特电导率。我们的结果将母体化合物的交换劈裂确定为一种描述符，用于指导通过化学可调性实现巨大的 Berry 曲率驱动输运响应。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.25584v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The anomalous Hall effect (AHE) and anomalous Nernst effect (ANE), which describe transverse electrical and thermoelectric responses in magnetic materials, respectively, are promising for spintronic and energy-harvesting applications. Here, we employ high-throughput first-principles calculations to investigate 2251 chemically substituted tetragonal L1₀ alloys. Among ferromagnets, enhanced responses emerge preferentially in alloys derived from parent compounds with small exchange splitting: no alloy derived from FePt, the archetypal L1₀ ferromagnet, reaches the high-response regime, whereas NiPt- and CoIr-derived alloys occupy it in large numbers. Small exchange splitting keeps majority- and minority-spin bands near the Fermi level, giving chemical substitution more opportunity to modify near-Fermi-level band crossings and amplify the Berry curvature. We predict a giant anomalous Hall conductivity of 2809,mathrmS,cm⁻¹ in (Co₀.₈Fe₀.₂)(Ir₀.₇Pt₀.₃) and a giant anomalous Nernst conductivity of 7.72,mathrmA,m⁻¹,K⁻¹ in (Ni₀.₈Co₀.₂)(Pt₀.₇Ir₀.₃). Our results identify the exchange splitting of the parent compound as a descriptor for chemical tunability toward giant Berry-curvature-driven transport responses.

中文摘要

在铁电体多尺度建模中，将原子尺度模拟与连续尺度相场模型（PFM）结合仍是一项基础性挑战。一个关键困难在于，如何在连续建模框架中忠实捕捉离散的原子尺度信息，同时准确表征介观尺度的材料行为。本文使用由分子动力学（MD）数据驱动的物理信息神经网络（PINN）。该网络的损失函数由两部分构成：一部分是监督项，用于拟合由含畴壁体系的 MD 模拟得到的离散空间极化分布；另一部分是基于物理的项，其中纳入稳态 PFM 偏微分方程（PDE）的残差。为确保不同损失分量之间稳定且平衡的训练，我们采用自适应梯度归一化方法（GradNorm）动态调整任务权重。通过最小化总损失，该模型不仅能够重建连续尺度下的极化场及其相关应变、应力和能量图景，还能够识别相场模型的关键物理参数，包括特征能量密度、特征长度因子、梯度能各向异性因子以及朗道多项式系数。通过在 COMSOL Multiphysics 中使用 PINN 预测的物理参数，并在有限元框架内求解相应 PDE，我们证明这些参数能够准确再现铁电畴结构及相关材料响应，包括应力/应变分布和能量图景。该框架为建立原子尺度与连续尺度描述之间的多尺度联系提供了一种有效方法，并有望针对广泛材料体系直接从极化分布中推断潜在物理性质。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.24733v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In multiscale modeling of ferroelectrics, combining atomistic simulation with continuum-scale phase-field models (PFM) remains a fundamental challenge. A key difficulty lies in faithfully capturing discrete atomic-level information within a continuum modeling framework, while accurately representing material behavior at the mesoscale. In this paper, a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) driven by molecular dynamics (MD) data is used. The loss function of the network consists of a supervised term that fits the discrete spatial polarization distributions obtained from MD simulations of systems containing domain walls, and a physics-based term that incorporates the residuals of partial differential equations (PDEs) of steady-state PFM. To ensure stable and balanced training among the different loss components, adaptive gradient normalization (GradNorm) is used to dynamically adjust the task weights. By minimizing the total loss, the model not only reconstructs the polarization field along with the associated strain, stress, and energy landscape at the continuum scale, but also identifies critical physical parameters of the phase-field model, including the characteristic energy density, characteristic length factor, gradient energy anisotropy factor, and Landau polynomial coefficients. By using the PINN-predicted physical parameters in COMSOL Multiphysics to solve the corresponding PDEs within a finite element framework, we demonstrate that these parameters enable accurate reproduction of the ferroelectric domain structure and the associated material response, including stress/strain distributions and energy landscape. This framework provides an effective methodology for establishing multiscale connections between atomistic and continuum descriptions, and holds the potential to infer underlying physical properties directly from polarization distributions for a wide range of materials.

中文摘要

我们报告了一种方法：利用 DFT 计算和数学模型，基于有机材料的晶体结构预测其非线性介电极化（PNL）和非线性极化率系数（χ⁽²⁾_IJK）。我们将这一计算方法应用于通过挖掘剑桥结构数据库得到的单组分晶体、共晶体和离子晶体。我们利用已知太赫兹（THz）发生器的实验太赫兹产生效率验证了这些计算结果，显示测量值与计算值之间具有一致性。若干经挖掘得到的结构显示出与当前最先进的太赫兹产生晶体 DAST、OH1 和 BNA 相近或更高的 PNL 值，表明它们在非线性光学（NLO）应用中具有巨大潜力。重要的是，我们还将所得非线性光学张量分量模型与常用的非线性简化处理进行了比较，表明综合方法应成为评估单晶材料非线性光学性质的标准方法。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.24835v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the use of DFT computation and mathematical models to predict the nonlinear dielectric polarization (PNL) and nonlinear susceptibility coefficients (ḩi⁽²⁾IJK) of organic materials based on their crystal structures. We apply this computation approach on single-component crystals, co-crystals and ionic crystals found through data mining the Cambridge Structural Database. We verify these computational results with experimental terahertz (THz) generation efficiencies for known THz generators, demonstrating consistency between the measurements and the computed values. Several mined structures show similar or larger PNL values compared to state-of-the-art THz generation crystals DAST, OH1 and BNA, suggesting great potential for their use in nonlinear optical (NLO) applications. Importantly, we also compared the resulting model of nonlinear optical tensor components with commonly-used simplifications of nonlinearity, showing that the comprehensive approach should be the standard method to evaluate the nonlinear optical properties of single-crystalline materials.

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.22006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional simulation of current-driven magnetization relies on fine-step integration of the spin-transfer-torque Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation, creating a computational bottleneck in parameter sweeps and control searches. In this work, we propose a physics-constrained neural flow map that learns finite-time dynamics directly on the unit sphere. The model maps the current magnetization, spin-torque strength, and requested time span to a future state in a single forward pass. Tangent-space projection and spherical retraction preserve unit magnetization during recursive, composition-consistent rollout. We validate the framework on single-spin trajectories under in-domain torques and previously unseen but stronger drive. Beyond the training horizon, it achieves an in-domain root mean square error of 0.00425 with norm drift at the 10⁻⁷ level. The flow outperforms an adapted Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) in in-domain accuracy and geometric stability, although the LSTM retains slightly lower out-of-distribution state error. The resulting geometry-preserving propagator reduces reliance on fine-step integration and enables physically admissible long-horizon prediction.

中文摘要

利用交错磁体作为可切换的垂直偏振自旋流源的前景，推动了对候选材料的持续搜寻；然而，具有显著自旋分裂器响应的金属d波体系仍然十分稀缺。在本文中，我们识别出一种能够在TiNiSi结构家族中支持金属d波交错磁性的经验磁性构型：铁磁有序的之字形链之间具有反铁磁链间耦合，并处于相对低对称性的晶体环境中。TiNiSi结构类型兼具这一磁性构型、广泛的化学可调性以及相互竞争的磁基态。通过结合对280种三元体系的热力学稳定性和磁基态进行第一性原理筛选，我们识别出16种金属d波交错磁体。这一集合重新获得了4种实验上已知的成员，即WFeB、NbMnP、TaMnP和NbMnAs，并给出了12种新的预测材料，其中ScMnP、TaMnAs、ScMnAs、MoMnAs、MoMnSi和WMnSi最具潜力。非共线计算表明，在这些体系中，共线交错磁构型均为基态。六种最有前景的新候选物均具有非零自旋分裂角和有限的反常霍尔电导率。值得注意的是，ScMnP和TaMnAs尽管具有适中的交错磁能带分裂，却表现出很强的自旋分裂响应。这些结果确立了TiNiSi型金属d波交错磁体作为高效电荷到自旋转换的化学多样化平台，并提供了一条由经验磁性构型指导进一步寻找候选材料的路径。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.23409v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The prospect of using altermagnets as switchable sources of perpendicularly polarized spin currents has intensified the search for candidate materials, yet metallic d-wave systems with sizable spin-splitter responses remain scarce. Here, we identify an empirical magnetic motif that supports metallic d-wave altermagnetism in the TiNiSi structural family: ferromagnetically ordered zigzag chains with antiferromagnetic interchain coupling in a relatively low-symmetry crystal environment. The TiNiSi structure type combines this motif with broad chemical flexibility and competing magnetic ground states. By combining first-principles screening of thermodynamic stability and magnetic ground states across 280 ternary systems, we identify 16 metallic d-wave altermagnets. This set recovers four experimentally known members---WFeB, NbMnP, TaMnP, and NbMnAs---and yields 12 new predictions, of which ScMnP, TaMnAs, ScMnAs, MoMnAs, MoMnSi, and WMnSi are the most promising. Noncollinear calculations indicate that the collinear altermagnetic configuration is the ground state across them. Each of the six leading new candidates has a nonzero spin-splitter angle and a finite anomalous Hall conductivity. Notably, ScMnP and TaMnAs exhibit strong spin-splitter responses despite modest altermagnetic band splitting. These results establish TiNiSi-type metallic d-wave altermagnets as a chemically versatile platform for efficient charge-to-spin conversion and provide an empirical magnetic-motif-guided route to identifying further candidates.

摘要：深度生成模型在复杂多体系统中的预测成功达到了前所未有的水平，例如 AlphaFold 3，这引出了一个认识论问题：这些网络是否只是通过高维插值记忆数据分布，还是能够自主推导出其潜在的物理定律？为回答这一问题，我们提出了一个用于提取生成模型所学习的隐式物理相互作用的框架。利用扩散模型得分场的零噪声极限与热力学回复力之间的严格等价关系，我们直接将训练后神经网络的内部相互作用结构与物理哈密顿量进行比较。我们将该框架应用于一种依赖序列且具有受挫效应的一维 O(3) 自旋玻璃，探究了仅在热平衡快照上训练的 O(3) 等变注意力架构的潜在表示。在不施加局域性截断或构型无关性约束的情况下，该架构中的稠密标量矩阵呈现出局域性，并形成几乎与构型无关的系数；这些系数在 2,000 条未见序列上的皮尔逊相关系数达到 0.993，恢复了自旋玻璃的微观相互作用。这为深度生成模型中哈密顿量的涌现提供了定量且可证伪的证据。

类似地，在显式水苯酚实验中，网络仅使用坐标数据进行训练。在具备足够表达能力的情况下，由分子图引导的 Pairformer 恢复了主要的键、键角和适当扭转势平均力势（PMF）扇区。将构型依赖系数进行保持扇区结构的投影并映射为常数后，在未见过的分子动力学（MD）数据上得到 (Rcₒₙₛₜ²⁼⁰.9669)，为哈密顿量部分涌现提供了分子尺度的证据。

English Abstract

arXiv:2604.20821v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The unprecedented predictive success of deep generative models in complex many-body systems, such as AlphaFold 3, raises an epistemological question: do these networks merely memorize data distributions via high-dimensional interpolation, or do they autonomously deduce the underlying physical laws? To address this, we introduce a framework to extract the implicit physical interactions learned by generative models. Using the exact equivalence between the zero-noise limit of a diffusion score field and the thermodynamic restoring force, we directly compare the internal interaction structure of a trained neural network with the physical Hamiltonian. Applying this framework to a sequence-dependent, frustrated 1D O(3) spin glass, we probe the latent representations of an O(3)-equivariant attention architecture trained solely on thermal equilibrium snapshots. Without imposing a locality cutoff or configuration independence, the dense scalar matrix in our architecture develops locality and nearly configuration-independent coefficients that recover the microscopic interactions of the spin glass with Pearson correlation 0.993 on 2,000 unseen sequences. This provides quantitative, falsifiable evidence for the emphemergence of the Hamiltonian in a deep generative model. Similarly, in an explicit-water phenol experiment, the network is trained only on coordinate data. With sufficient expressive capacity, a molecular-graph-guided Pairformer recovers the dominant bond, angle, and proper-torsion potential-of-mean-force (PMF) sectors. A sector-preserving projection of configuration-dependent coefficients onto constants yields Rₘ̊ cₒₙₛₜ²⁼⁰.9669 on unseen molecular dynamics (MD), providing molecular-scale evidence for partial emphemergence of the Hamiltonian.

中文摘要

arXiv:2608.23333v1 公告类型：新提交

摘要：类比于电子-声子耦合（EPC），电子-磁振子耦合（EMC）预计会影响磁性材料的电子结构、输运性质，并可能影响非常规超导性。然而，与如今已能在第一性原理框架下常规处理的电子-声子耦合不同，电子-磁振子耦合的定量描述，尤其是在输运方面，仍因缺乏理论形式体系而难以实现。因此，即使对于单质铁，仅考虑电子-声子耦合的计算也无法再现电阻率的大小及其 T² 分量。这一差异长期以来被归因于电子-磁振子耦合，尽管一直缺乏直接的计算证据，其背后的输运机制也尚未解决。

在此，我们基于多体微扰理论，针对共线磁性体系建立了一套统一的电子-磁振子耦合第一性原理形式体系，并结合机器学习自旋相关哈密顿量，以提供传统第一性原理方法无法直接获得的物理量。我们的框架首次实现了包含电子-磁振子耦合效应的从头算输运计算。将该方法应用于铁磁性 α-Fe，我们得到的电子谱函数与此前研究结果一致。更为重要的是，我们再现了电阻率完整的 T² 分量，其系数与实验测量定量吻合，并揭示出 T² 分量不能像长期以来所假定的那样仅归因于电子-磁振子耦合，而是主要由电子-声子耦合与电子-磁振子耦合之间的强相互作用所主导。

进一步将该方法拓展至反铁磁性掺钾 BaMn₂As₂，我们成功捕捉到角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）观测到的磁振子诱导拐点，以及约为 3 的较大电子-磁振子耦合强度，该结果与实验测量相当，彰显了该框架的普适性。本工作弥补了磁性体系输运定量理解方面长期存在的空白，并为研究磁振子介导现象提供了具有预测能力的理论基础。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.23333v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In analogy to electron-phonon coupling (EPC), electron-magnon coupling (EMC) is expected to shape electronic structure, transport, and possibly unconventional superconductivity in magnetic materials. However, unlike EPC, which is now routinely treated within first-principles frameworks, a quantitative description of EMC, especially for transport, remains elusive because of the lack of theoretical formalism. Consequently, even for elemental iron, EPC-only calculations miss both the magnitude and the T² component of resistivity. This discrepancy has long been attributed to EMC, although direct computational evidence has been lacking and the underlying transport mechanism remains unresolved. Here we develop a unified first-principles formalism for EMC in collinear magnetic systems within many-body perturbation theory, complemented by machine-learning spinful Hamiltonians that supply quantities not directly accessible from conventional first-principles methods. Our framework enables ab initio transport calculations including EMC effects for the first time. Applied to ferromagnetic α-Fe, our approach yields electron spectral functions consistent with previous studies. More importantly, we recover the full T² component of resistivity with a coefficient in quantitative agreement with measurement and reveal that the T² component cannot be attributed solely to EMC, as has long been assumed, but is dominated by the strong EPC-EMC interplay. Extending to antiferromagnetic K-doped BaMn₂As₂, our method captures the ARPES-observed magnon-induced kink and a large EMC strength of sim 3 comparable to experimental measurements, demonstrating the generality of the framework. Our work closes a longstanding gap in the quantitative understanding of transport in magnetic systems and provides a predictive foundation for examining magnon-mediated phenomena.

神经量子态通过将神经网络参数化与蒙特卡罗采样相结合，为量子多体波函数提供了灵活的变分表示。在这篇观点文章中，我们回顾神经量子态在凝聚态体系中的最新进展，重点关注受挫量子磁体、相互作用晶格费米子和非平衡动力学。我们讨论当前先进计算所依据的网络架构、对称性约束、优化方法和采样策略，并总结开展可靠模拟的实用指南。我们还考察了仍待解决的主要挑战，包括学习非平凡的符号和相位结构、控制变分偏差、施加物理对称性、将优化扩展到大型网络，以及实现稳定的实时演化。最后，我们概述了神经量子态有望进一步拓展经典模拟强关联量子物质能力的方向。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.21291v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural quantum states provide flexible variational representations of quantum many-body wave functions by combining neural-network parametrizations with Monte Carlo sampling. In this perspective, we review recent advances in their application to condensed-matter systems, focusing on frustrated quantum magnets, interacting lattice fermions, and non-equilibrium dynamics. We discuss the architectures, symmetry constraints, optimization methods, and sampling strategies underlying state-of-the-art calculations, and summarize practical guidelines for reliable simulations. We also examine the principal remaining challenges, including learning non-trivial sign and phase structures, controlling variational bias, enforcing physical symmetries, scaling optimization to large networks, and achieving stable real-time evolution. Finally, we outline promising directions in which neural quantum states may extend the reach of classical simulations of strongly correlated quantum matter.

中文摘要

直接从时空数据中发现控制偏微分方程（PDE），已成为理解复杂系统动力学的有力工具。在本工作中，我们将PDE-SINDy应用于众所周知的相分离系统，并考察其性能如何依赖于可用数据量、函数库规模以及噪声的存在。结果表明，方程发现的准确性强烈依赖于可用数据量。尽管利用有限数据可以识别出正确方程，但若干伪项也会获得非零的选择概率。随着数据量增加，这些伪项会逐步受到抑制，从而更稳健地识别控制方程。相反，增大函数库规模会不利于方程发现的效率。此外，对于Glauber自旋翻转Ising模型，我们表明，选择概率揭示了一组具有不同复杂程度的方程层级。足够严格的选择阈值能够恢复一种类似Model-A的动力学方程，该方程可以准确再现相分离和畴生长的动力学及统计特征。

arXiv:2608.20404v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The discovery of governing partial differential equations (PDEs) directly from spatiotemporal data has emerged as a powerful tool for understanding the dynamics of complex systems. In this work, we apply PDE-SINDy to well-known phase-separating systems and examine how its performance depends on the amount of available data, the size of the function library, and the presence of noise. Our results show that the accuracy of equation discovery depends strongly on the amount of available data. Although the correct equation can be identified with limited data, several spurious terms also acquire finite selection probabilities. As the amount of data increases, these spurious terms are progressively suppressed, leading to a more robust identification of the governing equation. In contrast, increasing the size of the function library adversely affects the efficiency of equation discovery. Further, for the Glauber spin-flip Ising model, we show that the selection probabilities reveal a hierarchy of equations with varying levels of complexity. A sufficiently stringent selection threshold recovers a Model-A-like dynamical equation that accurately reproduces the dynamical and statistical features of phase separation and domain growth.

我们证明，磁体可以保持完全共线，而其量子真空却在发生环流。在具有反演对称性的交替磁体中，一种由对称性允许的局域交错 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 耦合，会在动量空间的高对称点处，将一个无法通过规范变换消除的涡旋-反涡旋对印刻到反常磁振子配对关联中。在实空间中，这些隐藏涡旋产生了反铁手性的平衡自旋电流阵列，它们在相邻面元周围沿相反方向循环。因此，尽管经典自旋结构是共线的，规范不可消除的挫折仍然存在，而且完全存在于量子关联之中。我们的结果表明，复杂配对、规范不变量通量和平衡环流等结构——这些结构也出现在电子通量相、自旋液体和受挫量子磁体中——都可以编码在共线磁体的压缩真空中。

arXiv:2608.26260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that a magnet can remain perfectly collinear while its quantum vacuum circulates. In a centrosymmetric altermagnet, a symmetry-allowed locally staggered Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya coupling imprints a gauge-irremovable vortex-antivortex pair into the anomalous magnon pair correlations at high-symmetry points in momentum space. In real space, these hidden vortices produce an antiferrochiral array of equilibrium spin currents circulating oppositely around neighboring plaquettes. Gauge-irremovable frustration therefore survives despite classical collinearity: it exists entirely in the quantum correlations. Our results show that complex pairing, gauge-invariant fluxes, and equilibrium loop currents - structures encountered across electronic flux phases, spin liquids, and frustrated quantum magnets - can be encoded in the squeezed vacuum of a collinear magnet.

arXiv:2608.26265v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The non-Abelian statistics of Majorana zero modes has inspired numerous proposals for their detection and manipulation in topological superconductors. Implementations based on magnetic adatoms deposited on superconductors draw particular attention due to their capabilities for precise atomic manipulation and the control over disorder. Here, we propose a scheme for detecting changes in the ground state parity of a topologically non-trivial adatom system by passing supercurrent through their low-energy modes. We unravel characteristic discontinuities in the critical current driven by zero-energy level crossings. We apply these findings to a setup where the Majorana coupling is mediated by a single control magnetic adatom hosting a Yu-Shiba-Rusinov state, and test the robustness of our results against finite temperatures and different tunneling regimes. Our findings introduce a non-invasive approach for reading out and controlling the ground state parity of Majorana states in Shiba-Majorana hybrid systems.

多铁性半导体GeMnTe同时具有铁电性、强拉什巴自旋轨道耦合以及载流子介导的磁有序，使其成为探索电子、结构和磁自由度相互作用的独特平台。在本研究中，我们利用时间分辨磁光谱学研究了Ge0.85Mn0.15Te的超快磁化动力学。通过在瞬态响应中分离磁性和非磁性贡献，我们识别出两种不同的激光诱导磁现象，而二者均源于光生有效自旋轨道转矩。相干磁化进动源于激光诱导的空穴浓度增加；这一变化改变了拉什巴分裂且自旋锁定的价带态的占据，并由此改变了磁易轴。通过矫顽场变化观测到的瞬态磁有序变化，被归因于激光诱导的铁电亚晶格位移变化；这些变化影响铁电极化以及与之相关的拉什巴自旋轨道相互作用。第一类光学自旋轨道转矩此前已在稀磁半导体（Ga，Mn）As中被观测到，而第二种效应是多铁性拉什巴半导体（Ge，Mn）Te所特有的，为在自旋轨道电子学器件中实现磁有序的全光操控和自旋轨道转矩产生开辟了新的机会。

arXiv:2608.26364v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The multiferroic semiconductor GeMnTe exhibits ferroelectricity, strong Rashba spin-orbit coupling, and carrier-mediated magnetic order, making it a unique platform for exploring the interplay among electronic, structural, and magnetic degrees of freedom. In this study, we investigate the ultrafast magnetization dynamics of Ge0.85Mn0.15Te using time-resolved magneto-optical spectroscopy. By separating magnetic and nonmagnetic contributions in the transient response, we identify two distinct laser-induced magnetic phenomena, both resulting from photoinduced effective spin-orbit torque. Coherent magnetization precession arises from a laser-induced increase in hole concentration, which modifies the occupation of Rashba-split spin-locked valence band states and alters the magnetic easy axis. The transient change in magnetic ordering, observed as variations in the coercive field, is attributed to laser-induced modifications of the ferroelectric sublattice displacement, which affect the ferroelectric polarization and the associated Rashba spin-orbit interaction. While the first type of optical spin-orbit torque has already been observed in the diluted magnetic semiconductor (Ga,Mn)As, the second effect is unique to the multiferroic Rashba semiconductor (Ge,Mn)Te, opening new opportunities for all-optical manipulation of magnetic order and spin-orbit torque generation in spin-orbitronic devices.

三硫化镍磷（NiPS3）是一种具有XY型反铁磁有序的莫特绝缘体，表现出突出的物性。在本工作中，我们利用太赫兹时域光谱学研究了单晶NiPS3随温度变化的电动力学响应。当磁导率不能近似为1时，传统的太赫兹透射分析通常只能得到复折射率，从而阻碍了磁性贡献与介电贡献的区分。为克服这一限制，我们展示了一种能够将磁导率与电介电常数解耦的提取方法。在假设奈尔温度TN以下介电贡献保持不变的情况下，我们利用顺磁相的数据分离出13 K时的本征磁性成分。光谱的角度和温度依赖性揭示了一个接近1 THz的磁振子模（对于0°取向），以及一个由对称性破缺激活的区域折叠声子（在90°取向）。利用德鲁德-洛伦兹振子成功拟合了分离出的磁导率，从而能够提取该材料中的基本自旋动力学参数。

arXiv:2608.26405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nickel phosphorus trisulfide (NiPS₃₎ stands out as a Mott insulator exhibiting XY-type antiferromagnetic order. In this work, we investigate the electrodynamic response of single-crystalline NiPS₃ using Terahertz Time-Domain Spectroscopy (THz-TDS) as a function of temperature. In cases where the magnetic permeability cannot be approximated to unity, conventional THz transmission analysis is often restricted to the complex refractive index, hindering the distinction between magnetic and dielectric contributions. To overcome this limitation, we demonstrate an extraction methodology capable of decoupling the magnetic permeability from the electric permittivity. Assuming that the dielectric contribution remains invariant below the N'eel temperature (TN), we used data from the paramagnetic phase to isolate the intrinsic magnetic component at 13 K. The angular and thermal dependence of the spectra revealed a magnon mode near 1 THz (for 0ⁱ̧rc orientation) and, distinctively, a zone-folded phonon activated by symmetry breaking (at 90ⁱ̧rc). The isolated magnetic permeability was successfully modeled using Drude-Lorentz oscillators, enabling the extraction of fundamental spin dynamics parameters in this material.

Furthermore, we found no evidence of non-Fermi-liquid behavior in the high-field region, where the antiferromagnetic order is completely suppressed. These findings establish the essential thermodynamic constraints for understanding the field-induced spin-liquid state in CePdAl.

中文摘要

MnF₂ 这一教科书式的双亚晶格反铁磁体重新成为典型的交替磁体，然而，定义其交替磁身份的亚晶格奇交换作用仍在积极讨论之中：它与偶极-偶极相互作用仅以平方和的形式进入磁振子分裂，其大小受到抑制且符号被消除。通过超定的第一性原理总能量映射，我们将这一尺度确定为第七近邻交换不平衡 δJ₇ 约为 +8 微电子伏。所得哈密顿量在明确纳入偶极-偶极相互作用后，能够重现实验中的低能隙和可见的有限动量分裂。随后，沿 c 轴的纵向磁场 B 充当这一隐藏尺度的线性放大器，产生两种带符号且随磁场线性变化的读出方式。第一种是补偿场 B*（Q），即分裂达到最小值的位置；在由旋转关系联系的两个伴随动量点处，该场大小相等、方向相反：偏离零场本身就是有限不平衡的证据，偏离方向给出其符号，而其大小在本研究中约为 0.34 T，可给出该尺度。第二种是在固定磁场下两个伴随动量点分裂之间的对比度；在 1 T 时该对比度约为 0.14 meV，是零场额外分裂的六倍，仅凭两条光谱即可完成符号检验。两种读出方式在 0.12 meV 的能量分辨率下仍然存在，并且这一构造可以推广到任何易轴型共线交替磁体，从而使微电子伏量级的交替磁交换作用达到现有仪器的可探测范围。

arXiv:2608.26540v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: MnF₂, the textbook two-sublattice antiferromagnet, has reemerged as a prototypical altermagnet, yet the sublattice-odd exchange that defines this identity remains under active debate: it enters the magnon splitting only in quadrature with the dipole--dipole interaction, its magnitude suppressed and its sign erased. An overdetermined first-principles total-energy mapping resolves this scale as a seventh-neighbor imbalance δJ₇simeq+8~μeV. The resulting Hamiltonian, with the dipole--dipole interaction included explicitly, reproduces the low-energy gap and the visible finite-momentum splitting. A longitudinal field Bparallel c then acts as a linear amplifier of the hidden scale, opening two signed, field-linear readouts. The first is the compensation field B^ast(mathbf Q), the position of minimum splitting, which is equal and opposite at the rotation-related partner momenta: a shift from zero field is itself evidence of a finite imbalance, its side gives the sign, and its magnitude, |B^ast|simeq0.34~T here, gives the scale. The second is the fixed-field contrast of the partner splittings, simeq0.14~meV at 1~T, six times the zero-field excess: a sign check from just two spectra. Both readouts survive a 0.12~meV energy resolution, and the construction carries over to any easy-axis collinear altermagnet, bringing μeV altermagnetic exchange within present instrumental reach.

中文摘要

FeTe 作为铁基超导体中的代表性母体材料，为探索轨道选择性关联、磁性和非常规超导性之间的相互作用提供了理想平台。然而，应变作用下 FeTe 的关联电子结构与磁性仍缺乏统一图景。在本研究中，我们结合密度泛函理论加动力学平均场理论以及 Heisenberg 模型分析，揭示了关联电子结构的轨道选择性重构，并发现 FeTe 中存在一条由应变驱动的磁性演化路径：从双列反铁磁序演化为条纹反铁磁序，其间经过一个中间的竞争性错列 n 聚体反铁磁区域。适度应变会产生一个更具相干性的准粒子与受抑制的局域磁矩共存的区域。进一步施加应变会将 FeTe 推入不相干的关联区域，其中局域磁矩保持稳健，且低能态由 Fe-3d_z² 轨道主导。这些结果确立了 FeTe 中跨越不同磁性态和关联电子态的应变驱动演化路径。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.26652v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: FeTe, as a representative parent material among iron-based superconductors, provides an ideal platform for exploring the interplay among orbital-selective correlations, magnetism, and unconventional superconductivity. However, a unified picture of the correlated electronic structure and magnetism of FeTe under strain remains to be fully clarified. Here, combining density functional theory plus dynamical mean-field theory and Heisenberg model analysis, we uncover an orbital-selective reconstruction of the correlated electronic structure and reveal a strain-driven trajectory from bicollinear to stripe antiferromagnetism (AFM) via an intermediate competing staggered n-mer AFM regime in FeTe. Moderate strain gives rise to a regime where more coherent quasiparticles coexist with suppressed local moments. Further strain drives FeTe into an incoherent correlated regime with robust local moments and Fe-3dz^₂-dominated low-energy states. These results establish a strain-driven trajectory across distinct magnetic and correlated electronic states in FeTe.

中文摘要

交替磁体（AM）是具有动量依赖自旋分裂的共线补偿磁体，同时不要求存在净磁化。由于局域磁矩和由交换作用驱动的有序并不依赖相对论效应，因此可以在非相对论自旋群框架中自然地表述交替磁性。这引出了一个基本问题：在不存在自旋轨道耦合诱导各向异性的情况下，二维交替磁序能否由纯交换相互作用稳定？我们将 Bogoliubov 不等式应用于一个最小的 d 波交替磁自旋模型，研究了这一问题。我们表明，负责产生交替磁性的各向异性交换图样对 Bogoliubov 分母的贡献在长波极限下仍然只是二次项。因此，当连续自旋旋转对称性得到保持时，仅靠短程交换相互作用无法在二维中稳定长程交替磁序。相比之下，相应的三维体系具有有限的小动量贡献，因此并未被 Mermin-Wagner 论证排除。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.26738v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets (AMs) are collinear compensated magnets that exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting without requiring a net magnetization. Since local magnetic moments and exchange-driven order do not rely on relativistic effects, altermagnetism can be naturally formulated in a nonrelativistic spin-group framework. This raises a basic question: can two-dimensional altermagnetic order be stabilized by purely exchange interactions in the absence of spin-orbit-induced anisotropy? We address this question by applying Bogoliubov's inequality to a minimal d-wave altermagnetic spin model. We show that the anisotropic exchange pattern responsible for altermagnetism still contributes only a quadratic long-wavelength term to the Bogoliubov denominator. Consequently, short-ranged exchange interactions alone cannot stabilize long-range altermagnetic order in two dimensions when continuous spin-rotation symmetry is preserved. In contrast, the corresponding three-dimensional system has a finite small-momentum contribution and is not ruled out by the Mermin-Wagner argument.

中文摘要

双带超导体保持一个相对的带间相位，该相位可以在超导环中携带绕数孤子激发，并由两条能带中彼此独立的绕数支持。在满足反演对称性的超导环中，带间相位孤子是亚稳态，其与均匀基态之间由屏蔽电流的能量隔开。在本研究中，我们发现，破缺反演对称性达到足够强的程度时，可以使孤子成为真正的基态。在这种情况下，中心对称材料中不存在的磁电耦合在超过某一阈值后发挥关键作用，产生一个与绕数有关且关于绕数为奇函数的自由能项，从而使能量平衡偏向某一特定的绕数符号。一旦这种偏置超过原本使孤子处于亚稳态的能量代价，具有有限绕数的相位孤子就会成为基态，其手性由外加磁场决定。在平衡态下进行的电流-磁通测量中，这一效应表现为关于磁场为奇函数的孤子分支；这些分支取代了由双组分超导体构成的介观超导环中原本存在的亚稳态分支，从而在带间相对相位扇区实现了 Little-Parks 磁通子分支物理学的磁电类比。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.26782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-band superconductors maintain a relative interband phase which can carry winding soliton excitations in a superconducting ring, supported by independent winding numbers in the two bands. In rings of superconductors obeying the inversion symmetry the interband phase solitons are metastable states, separated from the uniform ground state by the energy of screening currents. In this work we find that, breaking the inversion symmetry strongly enough, one can make the soliton a true ground state. In that case, a magneto-electric coupling, absent in centrosymmetric materials, contributes critically above a certain threshold, a relevant, free-energy term, odd with respect to the winding number, which biases the energy balance in favor of a particular winding sign. Once the bias outweighs the energy cost that originally made the soliton metastable, a phase soliton with a finite winding number becomes the ground state, with chirality set by the applied field. In current--flux measurements performed in equilibrium states, the effect is demonstrated by field-odd soliton branches, that replace the metastable ones existing in mesoscopic rings, built by two-component superconductors, realizing a magneto-electric analog of the Little--Parks fluxoid-branch physics in the interband relative-phase sector.

arXiv:2608.26946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay between geometric frustration, spin--orbit coupling, and structural disorder can give rise to unconventional magnetic ground states in rare-earth triangular-lattice magnets. We report low-temperature magnetic and ⁷Li NMR investigations of the disordered triangular-lattice compound LiCaYb₅₍BO₃₎₆ (LCYBO). Rietveld refinement confirms a hexagonal P6₅₂₂ structure with partial Ca/Yb antisite disorder and fractional Li occupancy. Magnetic susceptibility and magnetization measurements indicate a well-isolated effective Jₑff=1/2 Kramers doublet with weak antiferromagnetic interactions (θCW approx -0.54~K). The specific heat reveals a weak anomaly near 0.43 K, suggesting the development of short-range correlated magnetism rather than conventional long-range order. ⁷Li NMR spectra broaden strongly upon cooling, consistent with increasingly inhomogeneous internal magnetic fields. The spin-lattice relaxation exhibits two relaxation components consistent with disorder-induced distributions of local magnetic environments arising from antisite disorder and competing exchange pathways. Our results establish LCYBO as a structurally disordered frustrated triangular-lattice magnet with correlated low-energy spin dynamics.

磁各向异性决定磁性材料的易轴，并控制其磁畴的空间排列。迄今为止，各向异性工程主要集中于重新定向易轴或调节各向异性能量，而这两种方式都需要较大的能量输入。在这里，我们以 kagome 铁磁体 EuTi₃Bi₄ 晶体为例，证明磁畴纹理可以在不重新定向易轴的情况下发生切换。利用低温磁力显微镜，我们观察到磁畴的优选取向会随温度变化从 a 轴切换到 b 轴，并且这种切换也可以由面外磁场复位触发。磁化测量和密度泛函理论计算证实，c 轴易磁化方向保持稳健，从而排除了传统的自旋重取向相变。相反，纹理切换由磁各向异性能量景观面内变化的温度依赖性控制，该变化源于两种衰减速率不同的竞争性相互作用：单离子各向异性偏好沿 a 轴取向的自旋分量，而最近邻各向异性交换则偏好沿 b 轴取向的自旋分量。此外，机械剥离得到的 EuTi₃Bi₄ 薄片中，临界切换温度显著升高。我们的研究表明，通过调节面内各向异性交互作用之间的竞争，可以在不付出重新定向易轴的能量代价的情况下，有效操控宏观磁性纹理。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.26954v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic anisotropy defines the easy axis of a magnetic material and governs the spatial arrangement of its domains. To date, anisotropy engineering has focused on reorienting the easy axis or tuning the anisotropy energy, both of which demand substantial energy input. Here, we demonstrate that magnetic domain textures can be switched without reorienting the easy axis, as observed in a kagome ferromagnet EuTi3Bi4 crystal. Using low-temperature magnetic force microscopy, we observe that the preferred orientation of magnetic domains switches from the a-axis to the b-axis upon temperature variation, and that this switching can also be triggered by an out-of-plane magnetic-field reset. Magnetization measurements and density functional theory calculations confirm a robust c-axis easy magnetization, ruling out a conventional spin-reorientation transition. Instead, the texture switching is governed by the temperature dependence of the in-plane variation of the Magnetic anisotropy energy landscape, which arises from two competing interactions with different decay rates: single-ion anisotropy favors a-oriented spin components, while nearest-neighbor anisotropic exchange favors b-oriented ones. Furthermore, the critical switching temperature is substantially elevated in a mechanically exfoliated EuTi3Bi4 flake. Our findings establish that macroscopic magnetic textures can be effectively manipulated by tuning the competition between in-plane anisotropic interactions, without the energy cost of reorienting the easy axis.

中文摘要

我们研究了处于合成磁场中的耦合一维玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的平均场基态。由此得到的相互作用耦合线模型具有一个连续的空间方向和一个离散的空间方向，为在少腿梯子的物理与扩展涡旋晶格的物理之间进行受控插值提供了条件。对于两根导线，我们研究了类涡旋态、偏置密度态和类迈斯纳态，并考察系统有限的纵向尺寸如何改变它们之间的相变。随着导线数量增加，基态逐渐演化为扩展涡旋晶格。我们通过数值计算发现，离散方向上的周期性边界条件能够促进形成同号涡旋的交错阵列，其形态类似阿布里科索夫晶格；而在小尺寸有限系统中，开放边界会将涡旋限制在合成方向中心附近的若干行内。我们的结果探讨了有限尺寸效应和边界条件如何控制连续-离散量子流体中涡旋的产生及空间组织，这对于未来在隧穿耦合原子导线或合成维度中的实验具有参考意义。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.26966v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the mean-field ground states of coupled one-dimensional Bose-Einstein condensates subject to a synthetic magnetic field. The resulting interacting coupled-wire model has one continuous and one discrete spatial direction, providing a controlled way to interpolate between the physics of few-leg ladders and extended vortex lattices. For two wires, we study the vortex-like, biased-density, and Meissner-like states, exploring how the finite longitudinal size of the system modifies the transitions between them. Increasing the number of wires, the ground state evolves towards an extended vortex lattice. We find numerically that periodic boundary conditions in the discrete direction can favour staggered arrays of like-signed vortices resembling an Abrikosov lattice, while open boundaries in small finite-size systems confine the vortices into rows near the centre of the synthetic direction. Our results explore how finite size effects and boundary conditions govern the emergence and spatial organisation of vortices in continuous-discrete quantum fluids, with relevance to future experiments in tunnel-coupled atomic wires or with synthetic dimensions.

中文摘要

在长分子中的电子输运过程中，通常认为只有当驻留时间远短于特征自旋混合时间尺度ℏ/Δ时，自旋才能得到保持，其中Δ是某种自旋依赖势的大小，例如自旋轨道耦合的强度。我们证明，在具有离散螺旋对称性的分子中，由于准动量空间中存在强烈的自旋分离，自旋保持能力可以显著增强，远远超过这一时间尺度。长分子中的这种自旋保真度与手性诱导自旋选择性相一致，表明在长手性分子中可能存在由增强的自旋分裂机制驱动的自旋依赖输运。我们给出了增强自旋保持的解析推导，并在紧束缚模型中对其进行了检验；结果证实，当螺旋对称性被破坏，或从离散螺旋对称性变为连续螺旋对称性时，该效应会逐渐减弱。此外，我们进行输运模拟，结果表明，在具有两个磁性电极的自旋阀构型中，会出现由对称性保护的高保真自旋输运所产生的显著磁阻曲线；我们提出，这可以作为一种实验上可实现的特征信号。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.27002v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In electronic transport through long molecules, spin is expected to be preserved only when the dwell time is much shorter than the characteristic spin-mixing timescale hbar/Δ, where Δ is the magnitude of a spin-dependent potential, such as spin-orbit coupling. We show that, in molecules featuring discrete screw symmetry, spin preservation can be enhanced far beyond this timescale owing to strong spin separation in quasi-momentum. This spin fidelity in long molecules is consistent with chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS), suggesting spin-dependent transport in long, chiral molecules with amplified spin-splitting mechanisms. We provide analytical derivation of the enhanced spin preservation and test it on tight-binding models, which confirm that the effect gradually weakens when the screw symmetry is broken or changes from discrete to continuous. Furthermore, we perform transport simulations to show that a strong magnetoresistance trace of symmetry-protected spin fidelity emerges in a spin-valve setup with two magnetic leads, which we propose as an experimentally accessible signature.

中文摘要

高频人工声子晶体提供了一个低损耗且适合片上集成的平台，但在GHz频率下实现陈型声子相仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出一种磁振子诱导的声子陈绝缘体，其结构为蜂窝状声子晶体，并在六边形中心杂化铁磁岛。圆偏振的基特尔模以具有相位绕转的方式与周围声子耦合，从而打破时间反演对称性并打开完整的陈能隙。在大失谐区域，这一机制形成一种有效的霍尔丹型声子模型，其中包含由磁振子诱导的复数跃迁。通过调节磁振子-声子相互作用，完整的杂化系统可以进入陈数绝对值为1和2的陈型拓扑相。所预测的能隙可以超过现实条件下声子和磁振子的线宽，从而使其能够在GHz声学器件中被观测到。我们的工作确立了手性磁振子-声子杂化作为实现磁重构拓扑声子学的一条途径。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.27011v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-frequency artificial phononic crystals offer a low-loss platform compatible with on-chip integration, yet realizing Chern phononic phases at GHz frequencies remains challenging. Here, we propose a magnon-induced phononic Chern insulator in a honeycomb phononic crystal hybridized with ferromagnetic islands at the hexagon centers. A circularly polarized Kittel mode couples to the surrounding phonons with a phase winding, which breaks time-reversal symmetry and opens a full Chern gap. In the large-detuning regime, this mechanism leads to an effective Haldane-type phononic model with magnon-induced complex hopping. By tuning the magnon-phonon interaction, the full hybrid system accesses Chern phases with tunable Chern numbers |C|=1 and |C|=2. The predicted gaps can exceed realistic phonon and magnon linewidths, enabling their observation in GHz acoustic devices. Our work establishes chiral magnon--phonon hybridization as a route to magnetically reconfigurable topological phononics.

中文摘要

过渡金属kagome磁体为研究层间堆叠、磁有序和能带拓扑之间的相互作用提供了丰富平台。在此，我们报道了kagome金属Co₃Sn高质量薄膜的分子束外延生长和实验研究；该材料此前尚未以块体形式合成。结构和化学分析证实，该材料具有六方晶格结构（P6₃/mmc），由直接A-B堆叠的Co₃Sn kagome双层组成。磁学测量显示出稳定的面内易轴铁磁性，其居里温度超过300 K。磁输运测量表明，该材料具有金属性，其载流子浓度约为5.01×10²² cm⁻³；从2 K一直到室温，其反常霍尔电导率均近似与温度无关，约为90 Ω⁻¹·cm⁻¹。第一性原理密度泛函理论计算结果将这一反常霍尔响应归因于自旋分裂能带中费米能级附近的本征贝里曲率热点。我们的结果确立了Co₃Sn是一种室温kagome铁磁体，并突出了层堆叠序列对CoSn家族kagome金属材料性质的影响。

arXiv:2608.27025v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transition-metal kagome magnets provide a rich platform for investigating the interplay between layer stacking, magnetic order, and band topology. Here, we report the molecular beam epitaxy and experimental investigation of high-quality thin films of the kagome metal Co₃Sn, which has not been synthesized in bulk form yet. Structural and chemical analyses confirm a hexagonal lattice structure (P6₃/mmc) composed of direct A-B stacked Co₃Sn kagome bilayers. Magnetometry reveals robust easy-plane ferromagnetism with a Curie temperature exceeding 300,K. Magneto-transport measurements demonstrate metallic behavior (carrier density napprox5.01×10²²,cm⁻³) alongside a temperature-independent anomalous Hall conductivity of σₘ̊ AHEapprox90,Ømega⁻¹ḑotm̊ cm⁻¹, extending from 2,K up to room temperature. Results from first-principles density functional theory calculations attribute this anomalous Hall response to intrinsic Berry curvature hotspots near the Fermi level in the spin-split band structure. Our results establish Co₃Sn as a room-temperature kagome ferromagnet and highlight the impact of the layer stacking sequence on the material properties of kagome metals from the CoSn family.

当前开发新型数据操控方式的研究，旨在实现磁性材料中磁化强度的超快控制，并在抗磁性材料中诱导磁矩。我们证明，在抗磁性量子顺电体KTaO₃中，振幅约为300 kV/cm的圆偏振太赫兹脉冲电场能够通过共振激发其简并软极性声子，诱导瞬态类磁响应。我们利用太赫兹泵浦-光学探测技术，通过时间分辨磁光法拉第效应测量了这种声子介导的响应。我们的探测方案被设置为抵消电光克尔效应的主要部分，因为该效应通常也会对瞬态响应作出显著贡献。随后，通过相减与相反圆偏振太赫兹辐射对应的实验数据，进一步抑制了与克尔效应相关的信号。因此，我们能够明确识别出KTaO₃晶体中具有温度依赖性的类磁行为，该行为表现为提取出的法拉第旋转。我们建立了一个理论模型，能够对测得的瞬态法拉第效应信号曲线进行良好的定量描述。然而，这些曲线的幅度呈现出出乎意料的温度依赖性，这可能是深入理解所观察到的声子磁效应的关键。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.27060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The current efforts striving to develop new ways of data manipulation are aimed at ultrafast control of magnetization in magnetic materials, as well as at inducing magnetic moments in diamagnetics. We demonstrate that in the diamagnetic quantum paraelectric KTaO₃, the electric field of circularly polarized THz pulses with an amplitude of sim 300,kV/cm induces a transient magnetic-like response by resonantly exciting its degenerate soft polar phonon. This phonon-mediated response was measured using the THz pump---optical probe technique via the time-resolved magneto-optic Faraday effect. Our detection scheme was set up to cancel out the major part of the electro-optic Kerr effect which also usually significantly contributes to the transient response. The Kerr-effect-related signal was further suppressed by subtracting the experimental data related to oppositely circularly polarized THz radiation. Thus, we were able to unambiguously identify a temperature-dependent magnetic-like behavior of the KTaO₃ crystal manifested by the extracted Faraday rotation. We developed a theoretical model describing well quantitatively the measured curves of the transient Faraday effect signal. However, their amplitudes exhibit an unexpected temperature dependence, which might be a key to a deeper understanding of the observed phonomagnetic effect.

中文摘要

过渡金属（TM）/稀土（RE）合金近年来重新受到关注，因为它们是阐明飞秒激光脉冲诱导的全光螺旋度无关切换（AO-HIS）起源的模型体系。近期研究在CoDy和CoHo合金以及Co/Gd超薄双层中报道了一种独特的单脉冲磁化反转机制，该机制基于畴壁运动和合并。已有观点认为，当Co亚晶格完全退磁、稀土亚晶格的特征退磁时间τRE（Gd、Dy或Ho）长于Co亚晶格的退磁时间，并且传递给Co的角动量减少时，便可以实现这种特定的翻转切换。对CoDy合金开展的元素分辨和时间分辨X射线光谱研究表明，在室温下其特征退磁时间为τCo=0.2 ps和τDy=0.6 ps。类似地，预计Ho会表现出更慢的响应，但其超快4f自旋动力学此前尚未得到实验研究。在此，我们对亚铁磁Co80Ho20合金中飞秒激光诱导的Co 3d和Ho 4f自旋超快动力学进行了元素分辨和时间分辨研究，以验证这一预测。我们在室温下观测到特征退磁时间τCo=0.22±0.01 ps和τHo=0.87±0.15 ps。这些结果表明，在Co80Ho20中Ho的退磁明显慢于Co，从而支持了由畴壁介导的全光翻转切换所提出的条件。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.27083v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The transition metal (TM) / rare-earth (RE) alloys have received renewed interest lately as model systems to decipher the origin of all-optical helicity-independent switching (AO-HIS) by femtosecond laser pulses. Recently, a distinct single-pulse magnetization reversal mechanism, based on domain-wall motion and coalescence, has been reported in CoDy and CoHo alloys, as well as in Co/Gd ultrathin bilayers. It has been claimed that this specific toggle switching is achieved when the Co sublattice is fully demagnetized and the characteristic demagnetization times τRE of the RE (Gd, Dy or Ho) sublattices is longer than that of the Co and the angular momentum transferred to Co is reduced. Element- and time-resolved X-ray spectroscopy studies of CoDy alloys have reported characteristic demagnetization times of τCo = 0.2 ps and τDy = 0.6 ps at room temperature. Similarly, Ho is expected to exhibit a slower response, but its ultrafast 4f spin dynamics remain experimentally unexplored. Here, we report on element- and time-resolved investigations of femtosecond laser induced ultrafast dynamics of the Co 3d and Ho 4f spins in ferrimagnetic Co₈₀Ho₂₀ alloys to verify this prediction. We observed characteristic demagnetization times τCo = 0.22 +/- 0.01 ps and τHo = 0.87 +/- 0.15 ps at room temperature. These results show that Ho demagnetizes substantially more slowly than Co in Co₈₀Ho₂₀, supporting the proposed condition for domain-wall-mediated all-optical toggle switching

中文摘要

反铁磁体将补偿性的磁有序与非常规的、依赖对称性的响应结合起来，为自旋电子学应用提供了一个很有前景的平台。本文表明，电压控制的磁各向异性梯度在缺乏热涨落时驱动 d 波反铁磁（ATM）斯格明子以近乎直线、无霍尔偏转的方式运动，这归因于其强补偿的陀螺动力学响应。热磁振子通过增强磁振子-斯格明子散射导致纵向拖曳增大，并通过依赖手性的偏斜散射产生横向反作用力，从而从定性上改变这一行为。由于反铁磁磁振子带结构具有各向异性，两种手性的磁振子在沿 x 和 y 方向传播时的相对输运权重会互换，导致横向斯格明子漂移的符号相反。相比之下，沿高对称方向时，两种磁振子手性保持简并，其横向贡献相互抵消，即使在有限温度下也能保持无霍尔偏转运动。因此，我们揭示了一种热诱导的各向异性斯格明子霍尔效应，其方向相关的大小与符号源于内禀的、对称性依赖的磁振子谱，使其成为 ATM 斯格明子在有限温度下的一种普适动力学特征。我们的结果为实现电控、热可调的 ATM 斯格明子输运建立了一条低功耗路线。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.27107v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated magnetic order with unconventional symmetry-dependent responses, offering a promising platform for spintronic applications. Here, we show that a voltage-controlled magnetic-anisotropy gradient drives altermagnetic (ATM) skyrmions in a nearly rectilinear, Hall-free manner in the absence of thermal fluctuations, owing to their strongly compensated gyrotropic response. Thermal magnons qualitatively modify this behavior by increasing the longitudinal drag through magnon--skyrmion scattering and generating a transverse reaction force through handedness-dependent skew scattering. Owing to the anisotropic altermagnetic magnon band structure, the relative transport weights of the two magnon handednesses are interchanged between propagation along the x and y directions, resulting in transverse skyrmion drifts of opposite sign. By contrast, along the high-symmetry direction, the two magnon handednesses remain degenerate and their transverse contributions cancel, preserving Hall-free motion even at finite temperature. We thus uncover a thermally emergent anisotropic skyrmion Hall effect whose direction-dependent magnitude and sign originate from the intrinsic symmetry-dependent magnon spectrum, making it a generic finite-temperature dynamical feature of ATM skyrmions. Our results establish a low-power route toward electrically controlled and thermally tunable ATM skyrmion transport.

中文摘要

在具有立方晶格和 Gd S 型磁离子的反铁磁（AF）金属 GdB6 中，研究了电荷输运和磁化各向异性的起源（Néel 温度 TN ~ 15.5 K）。精确的低温 X 射线衍射测量发现了小的静态 Jahn-Teller 畸变和纳米尺度的电子不稳定性（动态电荷条纹）。通过详细的磁场（H）-温度（T）相图构建，识别出两个主要的磁相 AF(I) 和 AF(II)。利用磁阻和磁化的角度 φ 依赖性，在液氦温度下发现在（110）和（111）平面中的 H-φ 磁相图呈现出类似叶轮的图案，其中 AF 相 I 和 II 由径向和圆形边界彼此分隔。这些结果支持 AF(II) 态磁结构中自旋密度波 5d- 分量发挥重要作用的观点。作者提出，条纹中的电荷涨落可能导致沿 <100> 和 <110> 方向排列的第一、第二近邻 Gd3+ 离子之间的 Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yoshida（RKKY）间接交换受到抑制。这些动态电荷条纹以及受振动耦合的 Gd-Gd 对共同导致了异常的电荷散射各向异性和 GdB6 中具有 S 型磁离子的叶轮式图样。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.27134v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The origin of charge transport and magnetization anisotropy was studied in GdB6, an antiferromagnetic (AF) metal (Néel temperature TN ~ 15.5 K) with cubic lattice and Gd S-type magnetic ions. Both small static Jahn-Teller distortions and nanoscale electronic instabilities (dynamic charge stripes) were found in precise low temperature X-ray diffraction measurements. The detailed magnetic field (H) vs temperature (T) phase diagrams were constructed with two main magnetic phases AF(I) and AF(II). Using the angular phi-dependences of magnetoresistance and magnetization, impeller-type patterns of the H-phi magnetic phase diagrams in the (110) and (111) planes were found at helium temperatures, which included the AF phases I and II separated from each other by radial and circular boundaries. The results argue in favor of the important role of the spin density wave 5d- component in the magnetic structure of AF(II) state. Charge fluctuations in stripes are proposed to be responsible for the suppression of the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yoshida (RKKY) indirect exchange between the first and second neighboring Gd3+ ions located along the <100> and <110> directions. These dynamic charge stripes and vibrationally coupled Gd-Gd pairs produce unusual anisotropy of charge scattering and the impeller-type diagrams in GdB6 with S-type magnetic ion.

中文摘要

时间反演对称性被破缺的 Weyl 半金属在其电子能带结构中至少具有两个节点，这些节点在动量空间中分离，并充当 Berry 曲率的源与汇。这会产生横向霍尔电导，即反常霍尔效应（AHE）；在最简单的双节点图像中，在零频极限下它与节点在动量空间中的分离成正比。在最近发现的 Weyl 半金属 Co₃Sn₂S₂ 中，已经观察到巨大的 AHE。然而，直接探测 Weyl 节点附近准粒子激发的低能区实验研究仍然有限。本文结合太赫兹光谱和基于物理直观有效模型的半解析计算，对 Co₃Sn₂S₂ 的本征低能旋光光学响应进行了系统研究。我们的结果为所观察到的磁光现象提供了稳健而清晰的解释，即这些现象源于 Weyl 节点在动量空间中的分离所导致的本征旋光性。此外，实验与理论之间的定量比较对材料参数施加了严格约束。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.27195v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-reversal-symmetry-broken Weyl semimetals are known to have at least two nodes in their electronic band structure, separated in momentum space and acting as sources and sinks of Berry curvature. This gives rise to a transverse Hall conductivity, known as the anomalous Hall effect (AHE), which, in the simplest two-node picture, is proportional to the momentum-space separation between the nodes in the zero frequency limit. In the recently discovered Weyl semimetal Co₃Sn₂S₂, a giant AHE has been observed. However, experimental investigations in the low-energy regime, which directly probe quasiparticle excitations near the Weyl nodes, remain limited. Here, we present a systematic study of the intrinsic low-energy gyrotropic optical response of Co₃Sn₂S₂ using terahertz spectroscopy combined with semianalytical calculations based on a physically intuitive effective model. Our results provide a robust and transparent explanation of the observed magnetooptical phenomena in terms of intrinsic gyrotropy arising from momentum-space separation of the Weyl nodes. Furthermore, quantitative comparison between experiment and theory places stringent constraints on the material parameters.

中文摘要

反 Lieb 晶格最近已成为研究 altermagnetism 的一个很有前景的平台，其中已有若干具有该结构的材料被提出作为 d 波 altermagnetic 候选体。本文建立了一个基于对称性的微观哈密顿量，用于描述这些材料，该模型同时包含子晶格和轨道自由度，超越了在研究此类 altermagnets 时被广泛使用的仅含子晶格的最小模型。我们将这些模型用于考察钒氧硫族化物家族 altermagnets 中的多轨道电子关联物理，这些体系在 altermagnetic 态下费米能级附近具有以 xy 和 xz/yz 轨道为主的特征。我们证明，xy 轨道对于稳定在单个 V2O 层内观察到的 altermagnetic 态至关重要，而 xz/yz 轨道中的 altermagnetic 有序则由 Hund 耦合诱导。此外，我们还表明，这些多轨道模型揭示了拓扑区间，在这些区间中，拓扑边缘态天然具有轨道选择性。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.27200v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The inverse Lieb lattice has recently emerged as a promising platform for altermagnetism, with several materials with this structure proposed as d-wave altermagnetic candidates. Here, we develop a symmetry-based microscopic Hamiltonian for these materials that includes both sublattice and orbital degrees of freedom, going beyond the sublattice-only minimal models that have been extensively used to study such altermagnets. We apply these models to examine multi-orbital electron correlation physics in the vanadium oxychalcogenide family altermagnets, which contain dominant xy and xz/yz orbitals character at the Fermi level in the altermagnetic state. We demonstrate that xy orbitals are crucial to stabilize the altermagnetic state observed within a single V₂O layer, and altermagnetic order in the xz/yz orbitals is induced through Hund's coupling. Additionally, we show that these multi-orbital models reveal topological regimes in which topological edge states are naturally orbital selective.

arXiv:2505.22559v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Excitation of ordered quantum phases gives rise to collective modes and quasiparticles, as exemplified by spin waves and magnons emerging from magnetic order. Extending this paradigm to ferroelectric materials suggests the existence of polarization waves and their fundamental quanta, ferrons. Here, we report the generation and transport of polarization waves, i.e., coherent ferrons, in the van der Waals ferroelectric material NbOI2. Upon excitation by a short laser pulse, the polarization wave emits intense and narrow-band terahertz (THz) radiation at the ferroelectric transverse optical phonon frequency, modulates the ferroelectric order parameter, and propagates uniaxially along the polar axis at hypersonic velocities of ~105 m/s. These long-lived, uniaxial, and dipole-carrying polarization waves may find applications in narrow-band THz emission, ferronic information processing, and coherent electric control.

中文摘要

我们从理论上研究了混合各向异性磁体 LiHoₓEr₁₋ₓF₄ 中非对角偶极相互作用的影响。受实验观测启发，即用 Er 离子取代 Ho 离子后铁磁转变温度 T_c 出现出乎意料的快速抑制，我们采用包含非对角偶极项的蒙特卡洛模拟来阐明其背后的物理机制。我们的结果表明，与稀释磁体 LiHoₓY₁₋ₓF₄ 中稀释会削弱这类相互作用不同，平面内 Er 离子的取代会放大这种作用。这将导致 T_c 显著降低，并且与实验数据高度吻合，从而解决了其与平均场预言之间的矛盾。这些发现凸显了非对角偶极相互作用在决定混合各向异性偶极体系磁性方面所起的关键作用。

English Abstract

arXiv:2508.11994v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We theoretically investigate the influence of off-diagonal dipolar interactions in the mixed-anisotropy magnet LiHoₓEr₁₋ₓF₄. Motivated by experimental observations showing an unexpectedly rapid suppression of the ferromagnetic transition temperature T_c upon substitution of Ho by Er ions, we use Monte Carlo simulations incorporating off-diagonal dipolar terms to elucidate the underlying physical mechanism. Our results reveal that, unlike in the diluted magnet LiHoₓY₁₋ₓF₄, where dilution weakens the effect of these interactions, substitution by planar Er ions amplifies it. This leads to a pronounced reduction of T_c, closely matching experimental data, thereby resolving discrepancies with mean-field predictions. The findings underscore the essential role of off-diagonal dipolar interactions in determining the magnetic properties of mixed-anisotropy dipolar systems.

中文摘要

非常规超导性与交错磁序之间的相互作用已经引起广泛关注。尤其是，通过抑制交错磁性是否能够实现自旋三重态超导，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们利用具有空位超结构的方格子最小单轨道 Hubbard 模型研究了这一问题；在该模型中，常规反铁磁序和交错磁序可以在平等的基础上出现。我们说明，由于几何阻挫和库仑相互作用，即使在半填充条件下，也可以存在具有交错磁性的金属正常相。利用电荷掺杂抑制交错磁长程有序，可以产生常规反铁磁自旋涨落和交错磁自旋涨落。当常规反铁磁自旋涨落占主导时，总是偏好自旋单重态配对。然而，当交错磁自旋涨落占主导时，则会诱导自旋三重态配对。我们还简要讨论了这些结果对于可能材料候选体系的意义。

English Abstract

arXiv:2509.09959v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The interplay between unconventional superconductivity and altermagnetic order has attracted much attention. In particular, whether spin-triplet superconductivity can be achieved by suppressing altermagnetism remains an open issue. We investigate this issue using a minimal single-orbital Hubbard model on a square lattice with a vacancy superstructure, in which both conventional antiferromagnetic and altermagnetic orders can emerge on an equal footing. We illustrate the existence of a metallic normal phase with altermagnetism even at half-filling due to geometric frustration and Coulomb interaction. Suppressing the altermagnetic long-range order using charge doping can lead to both conventional antiferromagnetic and altermagnetic spin fluctuations. Spin-singlet pairing is always favored when conventional antiferromagnetic spin fluctuations dominate. However, when altermagnetic spin fluctuations dominate, spin-triplet pairing will be induced. Implications of our results for possible material candidates are also briefly discussed.

中文摘要

我们在二维 WTe2/Fe3GeTe2（FGT）堆叠结构中展示了对反常霍尔效应稳健且可逆的电流控制。通过 Td-WTe2 施加电流，会引起相邻 FGT 层反常霍尔效应的巨大调制，其反常霍尔电导的相对变化超过 180%。对照实验表明：其一，在纯 FGT 中不存在所观察到的效应；其二，随着 FGT 薄膜厚度增加，调制作用减弱，从而证实其来源于界面；其三，当 WTe2 为双层时调制达到峰值，表明贝里曲率偶极矩（BCD）在该调制中起主导作用。我们提出，电荷电流 I 通过 WTe2 中的 BCD 产生面外磁化 Mz，而 Mz 通过逆磁近邻效应改变 FGT 的交换劈裂，进而改变其贝里曲率，并以非平凡方式影响反常霍尔效应。所展示的反常霍尔效应控制方法为磁性控制提供了新的可能性，包括研究反常霍尔效应晶体管，以及利用电流控制量子磁体，尤其是磁性绝缘体。

English Abstract

arXiv:2601.03744v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We demonstrate robust and reversible electric-current control of the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) in a two-dimensional WTe2/Fe3GeTe2 (FGT) stack. Applying a current through Td-WTe2 leads to a giant modulation of the AHE of the adjacent FGT layer, with the relative change of the AHE conductivity exceeding 180%. Control experiments show that i) the observed effect is absent in pure FGT, ii) the modulation weakens in thicker FGT films, confirming its interfacial origin, and iii) the modulation peaks for bilayer WTe2, indicating that the Berry-curvature dipole (BCD) plays the dominant role in the modulation. We propose that the charge current I generates an out-of-plane magnetization Mz via BCD in WTe2 and Mz modifies the exchange splitting of FGT via the inverse magnetic proximity effect, thereby altering its Berry curvature and nontrivially influencing the AHE. The demonstrated method of AHE control offers new possibilities for magnetism control, i.e., for the study of AHE-transistors as well as electric-current control of quantum magnets, especially magnetic insulators.

中文摘要

奇宇称磁性因其非常规的自旋劈裂而引起了广泛兴趣。然而，实现这种磁性的具体微观途径仍不清楚。在本文中，我们提出由条纹反铁磁体（sAFM）构成的范德瓦耳斯异质结构，作为实现电控 p 波磁性的理想平台。在 sAFM/金属/sAFM 结构中，主导的 RKKY 型交换相互作用由于堆叠排列的对称性而被抵消。这使得高阶双二次相互作用成为主导贡献，并驱动一个由填充控制的相变，即从共线相转变为正交 p 波构型。由此形成的 p 波相表现出可由栅极调节的艾德尔斯坦响应；该响应源于磁对称性破缺，而不是传统的相对论性自旋-动量锁定，并且即使在相当强的自旋轨道耦合下仍然稳健。最后，我们提出了实现该理论的材料候选体系。我们的结果表明，范德瓦耳斯异质结构可以作为非相对论自旋电子学的实用平台，实现对奇宇称自旋纹理的电控。

English Abstract

arXiv:2602.11251v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Odd-parity magnetism has attracted significant interest for its unconventional spin splitting. However, a concrete microscopic route for its realization remains elusive. In this work, we propose van der Waals heterostructures of stripe antiferromagnets (sAFMs) as an ideal platform for electrically controllable p-wave magnetism. In the sAFM/metal/sAFM structure, the leading RKKY-type exchange interaction is canceled due to the symmetry of the stacking pattern. This exposes a higher-order biquadratic interaction as a dominant contribution that drives a filling-controlled transition from a collinear phase to an orthogonal p-wave configuration. The resulting p-wave phase exhibits a gate-tunable Edelstein response, which originates from magnetic symmetry breaking rather than conventional relativistic spin-momentum locking and remains robust even under substantial spin-orbit coupling. Finally, we propose material candidates for the realization of our theory. Our results establish van der Waals heterostructures as a practical platform for non-relativistic spintronics with electric control of odd-parity spin textures.

中文摘要

尽管电流诱导的双态自旋轨道力矩（SOT）切换已经得到充分确立，但对多个磁态进行确定性电控仍是自旋电子学中的核心挑战。在此，我们在 SrIrO₃/SrRuO₃ 双层膜中实现了一种概念全新的多态 SOT 器件；该器件包含四种本征稳定且可通过电学区分的磁态，包括两种面内倾斜态（IP_c^±）和两种面外倾斜态（OP_c^±）。脉冲电流激发完整映射了这四种状态之间全部 12 种确定性转变，从而建立了由两个特征电流密度定义的稳健切换协议。原位扫描氮空位（NV）中心磁力计提供了此前未观测到的 IP_c^± 状态的直接实空间证据；自旋动力学模拟则揭示了一个两步切换路径，该路径由自旋力矩与四重各向异性能景观中的有效各向异性场协同驱动。我们对本征多态 SOT 器件的展示直接回应了传统双态 SOT 技术的密度瓶颈，并为紧凑、高速和高能效的多态自旋电子学确立了一种有力范式。

English Abstract

arXiv:2603.11656v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: While current-induced bistate spin-orbit torque (SOT) switching has been well established, deterministic electrical control of multiple magnetic states remains a central challenge in spintronics. Here, we realize a conceptually new multistate SOT device in a SrIrO₃/SrRuO₃ bilayer, hosting four intrinsically stable yet electrically distinguishable magnetic states, including two in-plane canted (IP_c^±) and two out-of-plane canted (OP_c^±) states. Pulsed current excitations fully map all twelve deterministic transitions among the four states, establishing a robust switching protocol defined by two characteristic current densities. In-situ scanning nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center magnetometry provides direct real-space evidence for the previously unobserved IP_c^± states, and spin dynamics simulations uncover a two-step switching pathway, driven by the concerted action of spin torques and the effective anisotropy field within the fourfold anisotropy landscape. Our demonstration of the intrinsic multistate SOT device directly addresses the density bottleneck of conventional bistate SOT technology, establishing a powerful paradigm for compact, high-speed, and energy-efficient multistate spintronics.

电子量子态的几何性质在固体的平衡性质和输运性质中发挥着重要作用。尽管人们已经知道贝里曲率会影响电子运动，但近期研究表明，量子度规也会影响超越绝热近似的电子波包运动。为了将这种非绝热动力学与多电子可观测量联系起来，我们推导了一种等价的半经典表述，该表述在 ħ 的二阶范围内有效。所得相空间测度和动力学方程将量子度规纳入整个相空间，包括实空间与动量空间的混合分量。我们表明，在空间非均匀体系中，完整的相空间量子度规会对绝缘体中的电极化作出贡献，并在金属中产生内禀线性霍尔响应。作为具体例子，我们研究了受到磁纹理和背景势作用的狄拉克电子，其中二者都在空间中呈周期性变化。在该模型中，相空间度规的混合分量会产生一个由两种调制之间相对相位控制的霍尔贡献。即使传统的反常霍尔电导消失，这种对相位敏感的响应仍然可以保持有限。更广泛地说，我们的表述为系统研究量子几何同时涉及位置和动量的体系中的平衡响应与输运响应提供了可能。

arXiv:2603.21262v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The geometry of electronic quantum states plays an important role in the equilibrium and transport properties of solids. While the Berry curvature is known to influence electron motion, recent work has shown that the quantum metric also affects the motion of electron wave packets beyond the adiabatic approximation. To connect this nonadiabatic dynamics to many-electron observables, we derive an equivalent semiclassical formulation, valid up to second order in hbar. The resulting phase-space measure and kinetic equation incorporate the quantum metric over the full phase space, including its mixed real-momentum components. We show that, in spatially inhomogeneous systems, the full phase-space quantum metric contributes to electric polarization in insulators and generates an intrinsic linear Hall response in metals. As a concrete example, we study Dirac electrons subject to a magnetic texture and a background potential that vary periodically in space. In this model, the mixed components of the phase-space metric produce a Hall contribution controlled by the relative phase between the two modulations. This phase-sensitive response can remain finite even when the conventional anomalous Hall conductivity vanishes. More broadly, our formulation enables the systematic study of equilibrium and transport responses in systems whose quantum geometry involves both position and momentum.

中文摘要

确定超导扫描隧道谱是否完全由晶体结构唯一决定，是凝聚态物理中的一个基本挑战。在此，我们系统研究了块体 FeSe 单晶、单层 FeSe 以及 KCa₂Fe₄As₄F₂。我们分辨出一阶、二阶和三阶棋盘状量子阱结构，它们与实验观测到的一对、两对和三对超导相干峰完全吻合。在块体 FeSe 中，量子阱促进实空间库珀配对，并形成简并的反铁磁棋盘状子晶格，从而产生玻色型偶宇称扫描隧道谱响应。在单层 FeSe 中，镜面对称性破缺抑制库珀配对，并诱导非简并的铁磁子晶格二分性，产生费米型奇宇称扫描隧道谱。我们建立了普适能隙标度律 Δ(T, ξ) = η(T)/ξ²，其中 η(T) 是与温度有关的前因子，ξ 表示量子阱深度；该深度决定超导能隙的数量及其大小。对于 KCa₂Fe₄As₄F₂，我们预测的 ±6.2 meV、±5.6 meV 和 ±4.2 meV 能隙对，与实验得到的 ±6.2 meV、±5.4 meV 和 ±4.4 meV 高度一致。这一量子阱机制统一了镜面对称性破缺、棋盘状子晶格有序、库珀配对、费米子-玻色子二象性以及半玻戈留布夫态等现象，为扫描隧道谱的解释提供了统一框架，并为建立统一的高温超导理论带来了新的认识。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.24906v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Determining whether superconducting scanning tunneling spectroscopy (STS) is uniquely dictated by crystal structure constitutes a fundamental challenge in condensed matter physics. Here, we systematically investigate bulk FeSe single crystals, monolayer FeSe, and KCa₂Fe₄As₄F₂. We resolve one-, two-, and three-order checkerboard quantum-well structures that perfectly match the experimentally observed one, two, and three pairs of superconducting coherence peaks. In bulk FeSe, quantum wells promote real-space Cooper pairing and form degenerate antiferromagnetic checkerboard sublattices, yielding bosonic even-parity STS responses. In monolayer FeSe, mirror symmetry breaking suppresses Cooper pairing and induces nondegenerate ferromagnetic sublattice dichotomy, producing fermionic odd-parity STS spectra. We establish a universal gap scaling law Δ(T, ξ) = η(T)/ξ², where η(T) is a temperature-dependent prefactor and ξ denotes quantum-well depth that governs the number and magnitude of superconducting gaps. For KCa₂Fe₄As₄F₂, our predicted gap pairs of ±6.2 meV, ±5.6 meV, and ±4.2 meV are in excellent agreement with experimental results of ±6.2 meV, ±5.4 meV, and ±4.4 meV. This quantum-well mechanism unifies mirror symmetry breaking, checkerboard sublattice ordering, Cooper pairing, fermion-boson duality, and half-Bogoliubov states for STS interpretation, offering new insights toward a unified high-T_c superconductivity theory.

中文摘要

施加一个垂直于螺旋轴的磁场，会将单轴手性螺旋磁体中的自旋螺旋压缩为共面的手性孤子晶格（CSL）。我们表明，与冻结的 CSL 耦合的巡游电子在光驱动下产生的高次谐波，能够分辨局域扭转的晶格尺度结构，而不是连续介质孤子的形状。对于均匀螺旋，高阶谐波始终处于微扰范围内。当绕转在磁周期固定的情况下发生局域化时，高阶谐波会增强许多个数量级，并对驱动振幅产生非微扰依赖。这种增强源于空间非均匀的有效跃迁，使每个孤子表现为跃迁振幅中的一个局域凹陷。当保持绕转局域化程度不变时，随着磁周期增大并趋向连续介质极限，高阶谐波强度会下降许多个数量级；在该极限下，跃迁调制在空间上被平滑化。因此，即使不存在标量手性和涌现磁场，高阶谐波仍能分辨共面 CSL 的一个实空间特征。

English Abstract

arXiv:2608.24984v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A magnetic field applied perpendicular to the helical axis of a monoaxial chiral helimagnet compresses the spin helix into a coplanar chiral soliton lattice (CSL). We show that optically driven high-harmonic generation from itinerant electrons coupled to a frozen CSL resolves the lattice-scale structure of the localized twist, rather than the continuum soliton shape. High-order harmonics remain perturbative for the uniform helix. As the winding localizes at fixed magnetic period, they grow by many orders of magnitude and acquire a nonperturbative dependence on the drive amplitude. The growth originates from a spatially nonuniform effective hopping that turns each soliton into a localized dip in the hopping amplitude. When the degree of winding localization is held fixed, high-order intensities fall by many orders of magnitude as the magnetic period increases toward the continuum limit, where the hopping modulation is spatially smoothed. High-order harmonics thus resolve a real-space characteristic of the coplanar CSL, even in the absence of scalar chirality and an emergent magnetic field.

arXiv:2608.25040v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Competing and coupled spin and charge interactions in quantum materials lead to a variety of ordered states where local configurations preferentially influence the long-range order. When these interactions are finely balanced in energy, disorder and fluctuations play an outsized role. Raman scattering is particularly well-suited to revealing the underlying physics in such situations because of its sensitivity to local environments and ability to reveal overall symmetries. We perform angle-resolved Raman polarization measurements on single crystals of the correlated, layered magnet, ȩSr2IrO4, where the Mott insulating ground state arises from strong spin-orbit coupling. We characterize the symmetries of both the phonon and magnon modes through comprehensive measurements in both the ab-plane and out-of-plane geometries from 10 to 700 cm⁻¹, and trace the evolution of these modes in both configurations to 12 GPa in a diamond anvil cell with perforated diamonds. Pressure does not significantly alter the lattice as the phonon modes shift linearly under compression, but at the same time the magnon modes become position dependent and spread over a range of wavenumbers. We attribute this magnetic heterogeneity to pressure-enhanced variations in the weak interlayer interactions, which may locally favor competing magnetic stacking configurations, and compare our experimental results to the predictions of linear spin wave calculations. 准二维磁体 Na₂Co₂TeO₆（NCTO）是 Kitaev 量子自旋液体（KQSL）态的候选材料。在这类材料中，压力调控受到关注，因为它可能改变 Kitaev 交换相互作用，而后者强烈依赖于键的几何结构。在此，我们报告了在金刚石对顶压砧（DAC）中对 NCTO 进行的拉曼光谱研究，施加的压力最高达到 16.3 GPa。根据拉曼模式的变化，这一压力范围被划分为三个区域。多个模式的出现和消失，以及代表性模式偏振依赖性的变化，尤其是 13.8 GPa 以上最为显著的变化，指向该材料中由压力诱导的相变。
